Bio: Lately he spends more time driving on closed circuits than on public roads. He still occasionally runs the Shutoko, but has entrusted team matters to his younger brother Tetsu Kobayakawa. His rough driving forged on the circuit remains unchanged on the Shutoko. Because his machine is tuned for high-speed circuit driving, he struggles through the Loop's tight blind corners, but compensates with skillful technique. Excels at drifting initiated by rapid throttle work.

Because his older brother Satoru Kobayakawa shifted his attention from the Shutoko to circuits, he was placed in the position of de facto new leader. His artistic drifts drew attention on the mountain passes, but here he runs solidly with a focus on grip. Originally a pass-attacker, his suspension reinforcement is thorough. Acknowledging the AE86's lack of power and tuning for mobility to compensate, it ironically ended up with a slight oversteer tendency.

During the period when membership swelled, he clashed with bandwagon 86 drivers, but things have settled down lately. Known for flashy driving, he drifts continuously even on the Shutoko. He likes passing rivals on corner exits, but often suffers from a lack of power. He favors drifting through corners, unaware of the speed loss from excessive sliding. Having raised his gear ratios to enter corners at high speed, his exits became even more sluggish, leaving him troubled.

He honed his drifting skills at the wharves and finally learned showy driving on the passes, but soon his battleground shifted to the Shutoko, where he is now studying showmanship here. Quite a senior member in the team. He is surprised that his pass-oriented tuning works even on the Loop. Paying little mind to ultra-high-speed battles, he excels at tenaciously carving corners with acceleration gearing and soft suspension.

A recent recruit and an engineering graduate student. He sets ideal racing lines and strives to drive according to them. His theory is flawless, but failing to fully control the car has kept results below expectations. He strives to bring the car into peak condition with tunes backed by calculation and data, but completely lacking funds was a huge miscalculation. An utter inability to handle other traffic is another headache.

Joined at the same time as Hiroshi Takayanagi, but with contrasting driving: he rolls the car on intuition rather than theory. Currently a part-timer drifting between convenience store jobs. Good at car control, but lacks concentration. Because of his poor part-timer life, he agonizes over being unable to tune his car. Trying to win in an underpowered car, he forces his way ahead and blocks viciously, but always regrets it afterward.

Display Name: ☆ハッピー　アンド・ラン
Bio: With little interest in battles, opportunities to show off his skill before members are few, but his driving technique has a solid reputation. Attentive and giving accurate advice, he is admired by all members. The car has no major modifications, but by drawing out 120% of its potential, he delivers above-standard driving. He favors grip driving, reliably clearing corners with classic 'slow in, fast out'.

Display Name: キス・ミー　バンパー
Bio: Worked diligently at a canning factory to finally get his beloved car. Consequently, his household finances are in dire straits, let alone money for tuning. He gets along with Seitaro Sada as a fellow hard-worker, but detests irresponsible people like Kazuo Kokubo. Unable to spend money on the car, he strives to cover it with technique. He claims to excel at quick turns by sliding the tail with early steering, but it looks like nothing more than sliding off with excessive speed.

Display Name: トーキング　ヘッドバット
Bio: By trade an unpopular comedy performer. He awoke to driving on a TV program promising one million yen for drifting, and is currently training here. He gets along well with fellow hard-worker Musashi Takatani. His jokes bomb, and his machine slips. He attacks corners with wild drifts, but because of excessive sliding, he is easily passed on exits. Drifting too much quickly wears out his tires, making expenses painful.

Display Name: ミスター　サンキュー
Bio: Failed to win a single race on the Shutoko for three years, but was picked up by leader Takasu and is steadily improving. A humble man who never forgets gratitude, he is an eccentric fellow who says 'thank you' whether he wins or loses. Admiring the leader, he tries hard to learn his grip style, but gets thrown around and saws the wheel nervously on corner exits. He wonders if adjusting steering response might help.

Display Name: スプリング　バード
Bio: Previously ran alone, but retired feeling empty. Later he met Yoichi Takasu, resonated with his philosophy of 'let's enjoy driving!', and returned to the Shutoko. It has been about a year, but he has not fully blended into the team. His technique surpasses the leader's, but during battles he suddenly loses interest and abruptly slows down. Excels at power drifting, sliding the tail on throttle while steering to clear corners without dropping revs.

A slacker who considers not just tuning, but even car washing a hassle. While he says he likes driving, even the attentive leader is at a loss with him. Many resent him, but his airheaded nature saves him from being truly hated. He boasts about his cornering, but that is simply because he does not carry much speed, not because he is skilled. Entering corners tightly at safe speeds and driving at his own pace, he is surprisingly fast in the end.

Formerly of ROLLING GUY, he transferred after driving an AE86. Upgrading to a car with more torque, he aims to be the fastest on the Shutoko. Quick movements that belie the car's weight let him gracefully weave through traffic. His light steering work, practically shouting that side-stepping is the essence of cars, stems from high-grip tires and solid downforce. Being slightly oversteer-prone, he sometimes scrapes the inside.
Relationships: Transferred from ROLLING GUY; Inseparable friend of Torakichi Yamada

Bio: Obsessed with 4-doors, refusing to recognize anything else as a car. He keeps running in search of the fastest on the Shutoko, trying to glimpse the other side of speed. Considered for next leader, he gave the seat to Kyo Takahashi and enjoys casual driving. Calling it respect for opponents when flashing beams, he is devoted to front headlight dress-up. Considering being flashed as well, he styles the rear grill too, hooked on appearance over performance.

Pulling ahead on straights with sudden power and blocking more than necessary is a nasty habit, but with his intimidating exterior, nobody wants to challenge him. He was shocked when a child saw his face and cried at a rest area. His seemingly vicious style is backed by solid tuning: acceleration gearing, lightening, and stiffened body rigidity. When no rival appears, he practices steering using civilian traffic as cones.

Nickname: The Red Flash of the Shuto Expressway
Bio: The phrase 'tuning-broke' exists for him. He modifies his car nearly every month, yet his skill never improves. He became poor-man friends with Masaki Tanaka of MAX RACING, another 4-door sedan crew, after meeting at a parts shop. Performance outstrips his technique, but his desire to improve is doubled. Slow on throttle work and corner exits, he does not realize it is due to poorly matched spring rates and dampers.

Originally a pleasant young car lover, but ever since an accident caused by a sports car violently cutting him off on the Shutoko, he feels compelled to take revenge whenever he sees reckless driving. He always initiates a battle when spotting a fast car. Raging during battles, his cornering is reckless and completely ignores civilian traffic. He sometimes uses his heavy weight to push from behind.

The former leader. Captivated by current leader Kyo Takahashi's potential, he scouted him from ROLLING GUY. A friendly rival competing with Sanpei Sugiyama, leader of the similarly minded MAX RACING. Driving the Shutoko daily for work, he knows and loves it better than anyone. Dreaming of battle being recognized as motorsport, he strives to avoid reckless or disruptive driving.

A science student with a dangerous look in his eyes. Lightening his car to the limit, he is feared for cornering that dives right onto the inner curb. He favors chemical tuning, testing various agents such as oil additives, combustion aids, liquid wipers, and ion coatings. While extreme lightening grants smooth acceleration and deceleration, ignoring aero leaves him floating from lack of downforce. Agonizes over the balance between rigidity and lightness.

Display Name: エキサイト　カーマイン
Bio: Driving a 4-door sedan, but secretly wants to switch to a sports car. Rumor has it he has had secret talks with Takaki Wada of MAX RACING, another 4-door team, about forming a sports-car team. Running a crouching stance with low front and high rear. An eccentric who deliberately softens his spring rates to enjoy body roll, which often causes wheel sawing on corner exits.

Owner of the restaurant 'La Liberté'. An unmatched car enthusiast with automobile displays inside the restaurant. Shutoko racers Hiroshi Kawaguchi and Mamoru Momouchi are regulars who frequently visit. As a restaurant owner, he has spent money on his car. Beyond boring out the engine, he modified the gearing for acceleration. With high machine power, his win rate in battles is also high.

Famous head waiter at 'La Liberté'. In the restaurant, when he sees a customer likes cars, he explains dishes using car analogies. He also plays peacemaker when the owner carelessly challenges customers to battles, acting as the team's unsung hero. He yields without forcing matters when someone wants to pass. If the line is blocked in a corner, he decelerates cleanly. A true gentleman who cares for people and cars.

Display Name: 公道のロマネコンティ
Bio: Works as a sommelier at 'La Liberté'. Naturally knowledgeable about wine, but even more so about cars, earning him the title 'car sommelier'. When he spots a car on the road that catches his eye, he flashes his high beams aggressively. He occasionally pulls tricky blocks, but basically avoids dangerous driving. Alternating between grip and drift, sometimes light, sometimes wild, he enjoys driving from the bottom of his heart.

Display Name: 黄金のクリームソース
Bio: Chef at 'La Liberté'. His cooking is original, but his driving is ordinary. The most short-tempered in the restaurant, his obsession with winning is strong. The day after losing a battle, his cooking becomes spicy and packed with spices, reportedly surprising regular customers. Mindful of battles on the Loop with many tight corners, he pays attention to suspension. Brake balance is front-biased with classic grip driving, and soft front springs boost turning.

Display Name: 深夜のア・ラ・モード
Bio: Young pastry chef at 'La Liberté'. Not stopping at dessert making, he aims for driving that can be called an art. A friend of Momouchi from GESELLSCHAFT, sharing dreams of the future. His cakes are sweet, but his driving is harsh. Forcing his way into opponents' lines in corners, he is often scolded by Miura. Detesting slammed cars, he deliberately raised his ride height, causing instability in corners.

Half French and half Japanese. Still an apprentice at the restaurant, but his driving technique rivals the owner's. With a mild personality he never picks battles, but never declines one initiated against him. Caring too much about stability, he lowered both front and rear ride heights and stiffened spring rates rock-hard. Naturally this produces understeer, but he covers it by decelerating thoroughly before corners.

Waitress at 'La Liberté'. Her constant smile soothes everyone, both in the restaurant and here. Her motto is 'always smiling, safe driving'. A 21-year-old who prefers battles over romance. Interested in mechanics, especially drivetrains. Studying hard to maintain efficient power balance, her car delivers more power than usual. Because she avoids reckless driving, she is not particularly fast, but prides herself on textbook lines.

Display Name: ☆ソード　オブ　ドラゴン
Bio: Outwardly the president of an antique trading firm, but his true identity is unknown. A charismatic figure adored by members. Rumors claim he was a test driver in his youth. Treats the disliked Tetsuji Eto like a younger brother. Fearless toward speed, he dives into corners fast and excels at gorgeous drift cornering by breaking grip with quick steering. Following cars back off, anticipating a crash.

Hanger-on of leader Kyohei Ryuzaki. Lacks real skill, but talks big. Losing composure in battles, he often makes late mistakes and loses winnable fights. Dislikes Tetsuji Eto, who is favored by the leader. Pulling ahead, he blocks nastily; running alongside, he charges dangerously; falling behind, he pushes slyly. Easily sullying battle etiquette, he believes it is driving technique, making him unbearable.

A part-timer doted on like a younger brother by Kyohei Ryuzaki. Disliked by members for his arrogant attitude, but his skill is real. Hates Yuzuru Mikami, who is all talk and flatters the leader, refusing to get within three meters of him. His personality has flaws, but his hands are good. Excels at machine control in high-speed corners with no trace of shake. Obsessed with lines, he snaps if his path is blocked.

The team's greatest humanitarian. When internal friction arises, he steps in as mediator. His gentle nature shows in his driving. The team, fracturing over Eto and Mikami, holds together thanks to him. Having thoroughly memorized the course, he clears corners safely with reliable braking and quick acceleration. Believing steady grip is fastest, his car is set up for turning and grip.

An information broker. Well versed in racer affairs across Kanto and nationwide. His driving is unremarkable, but leader Kyohei Ryuzaki valued his intelligence gathering and made him a member. He dislikes Tetsuji Eto, who broke the team's harmony. Though technique is low, he imitates driving styles collected from racers nationwide, drawing surprise attention. However, being about 20% slower than the originals, he cannot win real battles.

Joined out of adoration for the leader. Lacking ambition and talent, he makes steady efforts to earn the leader's recognition. Disliking Yuzuru Mikami, he often drinks with Toru Kamiya to complain. Bearing no ill will, he dives into narrow gaps without care, often charging into opponents. He claims minor scratches are a racer's badges of honor, but those charged find it intolerable.

An old friend of leader Kyohei Ryuzaki, though his identity is unknown. A member who rarely shows up, mostly driving alone. Slender and tall with sharp eyes, a handsome man who often has a woman in the passenger seat. Hating noise, he focuses on sound deadening. Besides a quiet muffler, any wind noise prompts thorough aero adjustments. Running low revs, some late at night mistook his car for a ghost.

Renowned for car control. Dreaming of becoming a pro racer, he started on the Shutoko as a stepping stone. Toshio Kamaya of GESELLSCHAFT is both a friend aiming for pro and a rival. To slide the tail smoothly, he runs tires with different grips front and rear. Steering response is quick with rear-biased brakes. He can enter a drift anytime, anywhere, from any situation.

Feeling down from a lack of rivals, he hit his stride after changing cars. He once drifted purely for fun, but influenced by leader Yuichi Ikeya's serious attitude, adopted it as a winning method. Excessive lowering and rock-hard suspension produce terrifying understeer. He pushed himself into a state where cornering is impossible without drifting, reportedly to heighten tension.

Ran mountain passes before running here a few years ago. His drift control is top-notch. His moniker originally meant 'traveler of hell', but his skill turned it into 'hellish drifter'. Falling behind first-stringers like Yoichi Watanabe, Satoshi Hoshino, and Akinori Yoshida, he is still quite fast in the team. Excessive sliding speed-loss and provocative weaving on straights keep his win rate low, leaving him in the second string.

Devoted strictly to the S13. On his fourth one, his obsession has reached enthusiast territory. Loving FRs, he seems suited to talk with members, but conversations subtly miss each other because they discuss FRs in general while he focuses solely on the S13. The car being well balanced, he earns wins with solid driving. Drifting is unnecessary for him, but he is addicted to the feel of sliding and wrestling the car down, occasionally scraping walls.

Self-proclaimed strongest 2000cc driver. Believing he is definitely faster than Satoshi Hoshino, he cannot accept being in the second string. However, when they raced once, he was beaten thoroughly. Despite harboring complaints, his driving is clean. He does not block excessively and yields in line battles. Yet he lacks no fighting spirit, burning especially hot in nose-to-tail duels.

Display Name: ファンキー　モンキー
Bio: Refusing to acknowledge anything other than FR as a car, he used to brag about being undefeated, but has become modest lately. Humility began showing in his driving, and his win rate went up. On terrible terms with Jotaro Hosaka of DRY CRUISE, who loves FF cars. Trying to cancel FR handling quirks with an understeer setup backfired on his drifting. Machine potential is not simple addition, so things rarely go by theory.

Uninterested in driving at first, he was drawn into the fun after learning to drift. Believing simply being able to drive is happiness, he questions dividing the team into first and second strings. Forcefully sliding the tail into gentle corners just to drift shows his stubbornness, but he is merely enjoying the drive. His drifting that blocks the entire line has a poor reputation among rivals.

Display Name: ファイヤー　バード
Bio: Since easing off drifting and attacking the Shutoko cleanly, his record has improved. This earned him a coveted spot in the first string, but he agonizes over drifting away from the team's philosophy. Out of consideration for peers, he sometimes drifts unnecessarily. He secretly switched to a grip setup without telling members. When drifting out of obligation he becomes much slower, gets passed easily, and loses.

A farmer's son from northern Kanto. Obtained a small special vehicle license before a regular one. Modified a kei car bought for narrow field paths into a decent machine. Members Yamashita and Tasaki are elementary school friends. Extremely lightened an already light body. Swapping the engine gave him ability to rival large-displacement machines. Unleashing kei agility, he is invincible in continuous curves.
Relationships: Childhood friend of Shingo Yamashita and Makoto Tasaki

Bio: Has a long friendship with leader Gaku Miyazawa since elementary school. The two competed in getting licenses and honing skills. Energetic since childhood and still quick to fight. A practical driver who dislikes theoretical drivers like Abe. Barely touching the machine beyond minor engine work, he battles purely on technique. High situational judgment allows him to take all-or-nothing gambles, though confidence sometimes backfires.

Elementary school friend of Miyazawa and Shingo Yamashita, but more introverted and quiet than both. Invited by Miyazawa in high school, he showed natural dexterity and holds considerable skill. The car was handed down by the leader, already fully tuned. However, carrying previous owner habits, he cannot fully master it yet. His casual driving looks rough, so he is often underestimated.
Relationships: Childhood friend of Gaku Miyazawa and Shingo Yamashita

Display Name: レンタル　ドライバー
Bio: Joined after the leader talked to him at a rest area. Borrows his sister's car to drive. His sister's boyfriend runs a tuning shop, so the car matches a demo car. 'If only his skill caught up,' sighs leader Miyazawa. Tuned so flawlessly there is nothing to criticize, but without driver skill, it is wasted treasure. Strong fear of speed prevents him from full throttle, losing easily.

Display Name: ゲーマー　レーサー
Bio: Skipped driving school and practiced on racing games at arcades, passing his license test on only the second try. Has a habit of explaining racing theory to people, making Tasaki avoid him. Shows precise cornering without a millimeter of error, but driving is rough and weak against unexpected movements. Fearing no speed, he drives flat out, but lacks consideration for other cars.

Display Name: ドリフト　クイーン
Bio: Runs an auto repair shop inherited from her parents. Attracted to the intellectual, romantic Tasaki, they are currently dating. Supporting her younger boyfriend while leading well, things are going fine. They met when Tasaki brought his car for repairs. Knowing car characteristics inside out, she draws out the machine's natural ability. However, an underpowered machine and fear of accidents stall her progress.

Eggen on by a cousin that becoming the fastest on the Shutoko makes you popular with women, he bought a car and started driving. Soon good drivers unpopular with women and bad drivers popular with women gathered around him, making him leader. Told by a senior not to rely on manuals for women or cars, he discarded all theory, showing creative driving unconstrained by dogma. His setup originality is still in the research phase.

A 23-year-old newspaper deliveryman who was the very first to run with leader Tetsuji Koda. Due to work he can only drive a few hours, running properly only on occasional Sundays when morning delivery rests. Started driving to get girls, but still has no girlfriend. Driving skill is real, but like romance, his final push is weak. Hesitation causes missed cornering timing, but fast exits let him pull away when rivals fumble.

Driving technique is decent, but his rejection count rivals Kawata's. Bonding over being unpopular, the two get along well. Rumors claim he powers up his engine each time he is dumped. Several breakups left him with a monster engine, but balance with the chassis and body is poor. Driving-wise, pressure from behind overwhelms him, so he prefers chasing battles.

Joined the team wanting a new lover after breaking up with a girlfriend of six years. However, while driving technique improved, there is zero sign of a partner. Kawata and Kato feel camaraderie with him. His skill in handling a quirky FF car is commendable, especially with a very twitchy setup. Because slight steering errors unsettle the car, he often suffers dramatic comeback losses.

An elite employee of Kuonji Heavy Industries who won battles and women on luck alone, claiming luck is part of skill. His personality is as light as his car's weight. Once quite skilled, his technique dropped while fooling around with women. Parts that can be lightened, from hood to buckets and doors, are stripped thoroughly, yielding overwhelming acceleration. Ignoring downforce, high-speed stability is poor.

Cheesy pickup lines suit him only thanks to his refreshing looks. Treating cars merely as bait to catch women, his technique is mediocre. By trade a studio musician. He can imitate drifting, but has not mastered it, causing huge losses. Spending money on exhausts and suspension, it currently shows little effect.

A medical student attending university on scholarships due to a poor family. Women around him pamper him, paying for all his car expenses. Being serious, he feels guilty driving such a car. He pours immense sums into tuning, but bolting on parts without foresight made the car unruly and hard to drive properly. Blocking is passable, but otherwise an amateur.

Recently became the new leader. Trusted by members for stoic driving and devotion to the team. His goal is making RINGS the strongest team on the Shutoko, practicing hard daily for it. Carrying the historic RINGS name, his driving leaves no openings. Setup is slightly understeer overall, with gearing slightly favored toward acceleration. Special air ducts on the hood catch the eye.

Display Name: 鮮烈のスライドテール
Bio: A dull office worker at a small firm whose popularity with women surged after his Shutoko debut, becoming a hot topic. Unpopular racers revere him for giving them hope. Completely unimagined from the outside, the inside is heavily modified. However, doubling as a date car, ride comfort is mild. His trademark tail slide is for impressing women, rarely used in real combat.

Quite a senior member. Respecting current leader Tsuyoshi Miyazawa, he still compares him to the former leader. Loving the team more than anyone, he believes his presence is vital for its strength. Emphasizing body rigidity, the interior is stiffened with roll bars. Performance comes first; ride comfort is secondary. Driving is solid, avoiding reckless cornering, though sometimes overwhelmed by speed.

The longest-serving member. Known across other teams as a master tuner, his driving skill is also solid. Supporting a leader nearly a generation younger, he receives high respect. As a master tuner, his balanced tuning is flawless. However, driven by a challenge spirit to try new things, he modifies it every time. Driving skill is upper-middle, preferring mid-speed battles.

A selfish college girl from a wealthy family. Formerly of The Road of Justice, she left after a shift in team policy. Often scolded by the leader for being rude to Satoshi Hamada. Rough, but by no means low-level, though weak in close combat. Having a tuner cater to her selfish setup requests, the car is perfect. Shows stable driving with decent power.
Relationships: Former member of The Road of Justice

Bio: Long history as a racer, but currently in decline. Close with the former leader, he acts defiant toward the current one. Finding interpersonal relations bothersome, he rarely hangs out with members. Set up entirely for high speed by preference, he cannot unleash full potential on his main Loop territory. However, talented in psychological warfare, he shines in close fights.

In charge of educating new members, currently mentoring Jin Mitamura. A man who moves at his own pace, showing little interest in leadership changes. Works in public relations at Kuonji Heavy Industries. Joined the company in the same year as Takafumi Iijima. Set up strictly for acceleration, cutting off the top end. Weight is reduced accordingly, but slight slack in shifting stalls his growth.

Recently joined the team. Currently learning routes and battle etiquette from Seita Goto. Sensitive to criticism about his driving, he mumbles whatever he was told repeatedly. Being drilled in fundamentals despite being a novice, his driving lacks amateurishness. However, rather than steady, plain driving, he aims for flashy driving even if slightly slower. Tuning is still left to others.

From a wealthy family, his sense of money is dull, unaware of how much he spent on tuning. Never arrogant about wealth, his naive innocence and airheaded nature earn high trust. The car, funded heavily, focuses on dress-up over performance. From grille, lights, and wheels to bumpers, skirts, and hood, all are luxury items, resulting in a 70 kg weight reduction.

Drives under the motto of minimizing tire slide in corners. Disagrees with Hidekazu Saito's belief that speed is life and cornering secondary. Works at an ironworks, providing members with homemade roll bars. Devoted to response tuning for quick behavior, excelling at nimble driving. Early throttle deceleration and extreme inner lines let him weave through traffic like a god.

Appears suddenly and vanishes before anyone notices. Belonging to the team, he prefers driving alone. On clear nights, he gazes endlessly at stars with canned coffee at rest areas. His home life is reportedly complicated lately. Excels at smooth line changes and instantaneous judgment, handling unexpected traffic during cornering well. Secret worries sometimes cause unbelievable blunders.

A scholar racer battling illness, whose driving theory is flawless. Records video runs for members and hosts review sessions. Wants to film Soichiro Watari, but struggling because encounters are rare. Drives cautiously as if inspecting every surface bump. Never taking the same line twice while gathering data, he often fails to notice battles initiated against him.

Display Name: サンダー　フレアー
Bio: Admiring leader Takaaki Toma, she spent comparable money, but ended up slower than stock and runs daily with tears of frustration. In love with the leader, but cannot confess because her previous team dissolved over romance. Thorough lightening and lowering improved torque-to-weight drastically, but lacking downforce causes understeer. Fearing drifts, she decelerates with full braking.

Due to aggressive lowering, he diets relentlessly to avoid scraping the chassis when getting in and out. Believing straight-line speed decides battles, he clashes with cornering-focused Hiroshi Hibino. Struggling with spring rates and dampers to solve lowering-induced understeer, he studies balancing acceleration and top speed. Idealizing straight lines through corners, civilian cars are his headache.

President of an auto club at a Tokyo university. Lacks technique, but attentive guidance makes him popular with members. Questioning tuning itself, he contemplates retiring to hand the presidency to Kazuto Miyama or Masanobu Shiina. Top-tier car knowledge led him to build a private garage on campus. Enjoys wrenching on members' cars, but began thinking true beauty lies in stock condition.
Relationships: Wants to hand over leadership to Kazuto Miyama or Masanobu Shiina

Display Name: ブロークン　アロー
Bio: Quietly supports the unreliable president, focusing on recruiting members to expand the team. Reliable, but socially awkward. Offering his car as teaching material for members ruined its setup balance: stiff suspension, raised rear, gearing unable to pull 6th, and conflicting spring-damper settings leave it barely drivable. It weaves on straights and bogs in corners.

Regarded as the next president in driving skill, but lacks popularity. Members are fed up with his extreme egoism. Rena Okamoto, sensing strange manly spirit in his lone path, is his sole confidant. Forcing reckless inside dives mirrors his selfish personality. Weaving provocatively on straights makes him annoying once ahead. That he never crashes must be due to skill.

Drives safely by day, but gracefully attacks corners with supple feline suspension at night. Recommends Kazuto Miyama for next president. Nursing an unspoken crush on racer idol Hisako Akiya as an untouchable flower. Excels at grip driving, clearing corners tenaciously on soft suspension. Acceleration is boosted, making passes hard without long straights. Somewhat timid, he is weak against pushes and charges.
Relationships: Has a crush on Hisako Akiya

Bio: An idol presence among racers. Beyond cute looks, countless men fall for her personality. An unverified age is slightly scary. Troubled by persistent stalking from Kazuyuki Inagoshi of RHYTHM BOX. Final drive is geared low for intense engine braking. Braking minimally makes her moves hard to predict for chasers, resulting in a surprisingly high win rate.

Best friend of Hisako Akiya. Knowing little about cars, she joined the club out of worry for her friend. Also serves as bodyguard repelling Kazuyuki Inagoshi of RHYTHM BOX. Lacking mechanical knowledge, she asked the leader to set it up so it drives safely no matter what. Memorizing the course through repetition, she drives ideal lines. Reportedly fastest when chasing off Inagoshi.
Relationships: Best friend and protector of Hisako Akiya

Bio: Gentle normally, but transforms behind the wheel. Having saved money, he bought a new car and drives even more ruthlessly. Favorite phrase: 'red cars are three times faster'. Secretly quite an anime otaku. Intimidates rivals with overwhelming power and speed, holding his line even by ramming opponents aside. Heavy weight adds destructive force. A low center of gravity provides ironclad blocking.

Display Name: ゴールデン　ビースト
Bio: Swapped cars to match the leader. Pursuing pure power, straight speed is everything. Barely survived an overshoot into a corner recently, after which he bought the latest harnesses and airbags. Shows fearless corner entries early on, but slows down as fear of crashes returns. Wins by pulling away early, but is utterly weak against tenacious pursuers.

Display Name: クレイジー　フーリガン
Bio: Focusing on lightening alongside power, his tuning is a step ahead of members. Frequently visits Akira Ito of SS LIMITED for lightening advice. Despite a big sedan, he clears corners nimbly with an extremely lightened chassis. Rocket-like exit acceleration comes from big power, but fearing engine durability, he dislikes revving high.

Entered this world influenced by younger brother Yuki Wada of FREE WAY. Secretly wants an open-top roadster, but drives a 4-door for his family. Loves fighting games, preferring ninja characters. Basically uses power drifts, but sedan weight hampers deceleration. Relying on tires and downforce to cope, the idea of body lightening inexplicably never crossed his mind.

Ran drag races around Yokohama previously. His previous car was totaled in a crash right after finally dialing it in for here. Bonds over tuning poverty with Takahiro Eguchi of SS LIMITED. Being freshly bought, setups are inadequate, getting by on high-speed gearing. Fast on straights and downhills, but weepingly slow in corners. Favorite phrase: 'sports cars are supposed to be fast'.

Display Name: 高速のブルーサンダー
Bio: One of the self-proclaimed Three Musketeers of High Speed. Shows powerful driving unique to big sedans, but wasted movements show suspension losing to power. Believing sharpness matters more than power, he drifts from team ideology. Tuning for lightness and response, he built agility at low speeds. Currently mastering grip driving where entry and exit speeds barely differ.

Display Name: 高速のホワイトブレード
Bio: One of the self-proclaimed Three Musketeers of High Speed. Motto: 'bigger is better'. Once thought attacking the Shutoko in heavy cars was stylish, but now considers body lightening necessary over pure power. Believing big cars have large tuning capacity, he modified not only engine bore, but transmission and gears. Having spent heavily on his car, he hesitates to step fully on the throttle.

Display Name: 高速のブラッドレイン
Bio: Loves battles more than three meals a day. Lives to beat sports cars in big sedans. Dragged into the Three Musketeers of High Speed by Takaoka and Sugano over rebellion against the team, but lacks political ideology. Flashes high beams instantly when spotting fast cars. Blasting away regardless of opponent reaction, he watches them shrink in his mirror, drawing claims of ambushing.

A spirited racer and private tuner. Express victories tie into circuits, so she aggressively challenges fast drivers. Agonizing over whether to suggest retirement to the aging Kangoro Matsuda. Losing a battle leaves her silent for a day, not out of anger, but from conceiving new tuning and setup ideas. Never skips practice to drift without killing speed.
Relationships: Considering asking Kangoro Matsuda to retire

Display Name: ディープ　グリーン
Bio: A used car salesman. Knowledgeable about cars, guessing modifications simply by riding. Advises the leader on tuning, but low driving skill leaves him low in team hierarchy. Getting cheap dealer parts, he lightened the car with composite bumpers and spoilers. Shows magnificent corner drifts, but occasionally stops in a half-spin.

Display Name: ホワイト　レボリューション
Bio: Pursues beautiful driving over speed. Bound to 'it is not a win unless beautiful', he throws away winnable races. Conversely, he boasts about beautifully won battles years later as if yesterday. His ideal is passing on the inside of corners rather than runaway wins. Sticking to tails and stalking openings, he passes at the opponent's strongest point, instantly shattering their morale.

Display Name: ホストマン　ハット
Bio: A host at a Shinjuku club. Handling customers improved after swapping an A80 for an NA1, but car control remains poor. None of the female members falling for him wounds his host pride. Relying entirely on performance, overspeed cornering chills his spine. An extravagant man who wants to drift, yet complains that excellent car grip clings too well to the road.

Display Name: ブラック　シンデレラ
Bio: A fashion model who also races on circuits. One year since her glamorous Shutoko debut, improving skill boosted her battle results. Often meets Satoru Kobayakawa of ROLLING GUY at circuits. Having circuit experience, high-speed behavior control is second nature. Knowing the car's absolute limits, she masters the razor-thin edge. Holds high pride as a license holder.

Display Name: アンフィニ　イエロー
Bio: Insisted on yellow cars for over 20 years. Long Shutoko history, but feeling the physical limits of aging. Knowing an accident is fatal, lingering battle passion keeps 'retirement' unspoken. Knowing every bolt and nut of his longtime companion, his driving is a 'Japanese katana' compared to Sato's 'Western rapier': razor-sharp with deep quirks forged by technique and experience.

Reportedly an ex-police official. Real-time traffic data on accidents and roadwork lets him attack under prime conditions. Imagines his family whenever tempted into reckless driving. Avoids involving other cars, never challenging in traffic, but always accepts challenges. Drives cleanly, passing corners and traffic without strain.

Awoke to the night expressway after marriage. Running nightly and battling until dawn, he arrives home in the morning. Dozing at his desk made him a layoff target, leading to separation from his wife with divorce imminent. Rough technique improved rapidly into real skill. Venting stress with aggressive lines borders on accidents. Budget dried up right after tires and aero.

Display Name: スイート　サレンダー
Bio: A math teacher at a Tokyo metropolitan high school. Values data over feeling, trusting only quantified metrics. A laptop always sits in the passenger seat recording run data. Trades info via email with other teams. Having mapped the course into data, memorizing speed tolerances for every corner lets her display waste-free grip driving, but handles traffic terribly.

Webmaster of an automotive site getting over 10,000 hits daily. Uploads videos of his runs, gathering feedback to study. Met teammate Michika Sano in chat, now email friends. Studious effort improved technique, but absorbing diverse opinions robbed his driving of personality. Hooked on the internet, degraded vision makes him fear high speed.

Display Name: グレート　ファイナンス
Bio: A businessman at a major brokerage. Occupational habits make him calculate investment efficiency even for tuning, often losing by a hair. Troubled by lending money to several members who never repay. Modifying engine, body, aero, and dress-up leaves few stock parts, yet half-baked levels barely change overall performance. Car instability causes wandering on straights.

A part-timer at a used record shop. Plays different music each drive and matches his driving to the track. Painted the car in bizarre colors, proud of its artistry, but annoyed when members called it surreal. Influenced by music, driving lacks consistency; braking points and lines change drastically if tracks change mid-battle. Tends to stall and wander on corner exits.

Avoids reckless driving since being caught in an expressway accident. Battle win rate dropped, but a stubborn nature cannot forgive such cowardice. Wondering when he will conquer fear and unleash sealed potential. Mind aims for safety while the body remembers attack driving. Slow in blind corners, but sharp in open corners; unable to pin the throttle on straights.

Sufficient skill and experience as leader, driving as if allied with the devil. Loves rotary engines, pleased by growing membership, but worries about rift between drift and grip factions. Flexible cornering between drift and grip is exquisite; once ahead, passing back in corners is hard. Extremely confident, he never blocks, which might be an opening.

A well-known racer in Kansai who moved to Kanto two years ago, now gaining fame on the Shutoko. Manager of a fast-food burger chain, praised by staff and customers for an affable smile. Boasts sawing quick steering inputs to maintain grip through high-speed corners. Having virtually no steering play, he sometimes wanders or saws violently on straights.

Weaves through traffic with natural intuition, but inexperience leaves battle driving rough. Suspects Mochida has feelings for her due to constant rivalry, and does not mind it. Natural passing skill shines as traffic thickens. However, inexperience causes inconsistent cornering; fear in deep corners prompts hard braking, breaking grip into slides.

Not particularly fast, but hates losing. Conscious of Suzuna in the same car, checking her vehicle and driving whenever they meet. Misunderstood by peers, it is pure rivalry without romance. Setting gears for acceleration achieved strong engine braking on entry and quick exit acceleration, finally learning agile cornering.

Display Name: シューティング　スター
Bio: He idolizes Yoichi Sumi of Super Speed Wagon, his university senior, but shied away from wagons and joined this team instead. He is reasonably skilled, but with no real attachment to winning he gives up the moment he is dropped. A drift-faction man even within the team, he excels at nimble drifts that dance the car left and right. He enters corners smoothly sideways and leaves them on the throttle, so his corner exits are quick.

A great deal of money has gone into his car, but his driving is nothing special. He gives up at the slightest dip in mood. Known for flashy dress-up, he chose his bumper and spoiler for looks over aerodynamic efficiency. He seems to be the son of a wealthy family. The machine he tuned with sheer money is a monster, but his driving skill lags behind it: he overdoes the throttle and spins the wheels on acceleration, overspeeds corners so his exits are slow, and weaves on the straights.

A struggling singer whose living is looked after by Kagetsu. He joined the team only to stay in Kagetsu's good graces, and he spends his days drowning the fear of being abandoned in his car. Hardworking by nature, his skill has been improving. He tends to bleed speed by over-drifting until the car is fully sideways in corners, but he deserves credit for controlling the car's behavior well. With enough money for the car, he could boast one of the best win rates on the team.

He took the leader's seat by driving out the former leader, Hiroki Itsuki, known as True Slide. A fairly famous VIP-car owner, he has been covered by magazines many times. Leo, blood type O. He likes flashy driving and, when he has room to spare, puts on one display after another as if showing off to his opponent, but he never lets his guard down. He has cut weight by replacing the hood, doors and more.

The instigator of the former leader's exile. He skillfully egged on the current leader, Kenji Kawasaki, to drive out the former leader, with whom he had long been at odds. His mild appearance does not suggest a schemer. Cancer, blood type B. To be sure of winning, both his tuning and his driving are solid. His driving lacks flair but his real combat strength is overwhelming; having simulated many situations, he adapts flexibly. His movements are efficient and leave no openings.

The former leader's favorite disciple, he betrayed his master without hesitation when current leader Kenji Kawasaki staged his coup, and now strives to curry favor with the new leader. A giant at 2 m and 150 kg, his byname comes from his build. Taurus, blood type A. He lacks burst speed but drives on sheer force of will and is almost never beaten. However, he never challenges opponents who look fast, so his record is rather dubious. His machine's looks can be summed up in one word: flashy.

Close to the former leader, True Slide Hiroki Itsuki, he harbors rebellion against the current leader. He haunts the Shuto every day, yet has started only one battle himself. Libra, blood type O. He does not pick fights, but that does not mean he is poor; his tuning is surprisingly thorough. What he lacks is fighting spirit, and his kindness shows at odd moments, so he gets passed just one step short of victory.

The team's liaison. After the internal strife damaged the team's reputation, he spends his days negotiating with other teams to win back their trust. He was reasonably close to the former leader but follows the current one without complaint. Gemini, blood type AB. For all his flashy body tuning, the inside is surprisingly ordinary; engine and suspension stay within textbook settings. Overconfident in his own ability, he loses in situations where nobody expects it.

He lives to throw backfires. Racers following him imagined flames shooting from his car and began muttering his byname. He joined after Kawasaki became leader. Pisces, blood type B. Setting aside the nearly pointless afterfire, he is particular about brake balance and owns well over 100 brake pads, some of which are merely collector's items.

As his byname suggests, he brings misfortune to every rival he meets. A member since the team's founding, he lives by the motto of trying many machines and has already switched cars over 30 times. Pisces, blood type AB. That he makes rivals unlucky seems to be just superstition; if there is a reason, it may be that his driving irritates opponents. He remains entirely at his own pace.

His hearing is far beyond ordinary people's, and he catches even faint changes in sound while driving. He formed the team to enjoy driving, but recently declared a shift toward a merit-based approach and renamed the team accordingly. Using his hearing, his blocking and shift work are flawless and he analyzes faults quickly. He pays attention to sound deadening so he can hear better. His driving is orthodox and his tuning is balanced.

A member since the founding. Called a famous duo with leader Yasuhiro Hashimoto, they once boasted an undefeated legend. But he could not keep up with the team's sudden change of course and watches the leader, burning to conquer every area, with cool eyes. He once ran very hard settings, now somewhat milder, though the engine under the hood is still a monster. His driving is highly aggressive, attacking from lines opponents never expect.

He joined the team out of admiration for leader Yasuhiro Hashimoto. He was sincerely moved by the team's new policy and declares he will follow wherever it leads; the leader finds him reliable. A former professional boxer. He lets the opponent lead, sticks exactly one car length behind, then approaches corners within a hair of contact, and passes when the opponent flinches. He does not take reckless risks, however.

A longtime member. He looks at the leader's burning ambition to conquer every area with a scornful, it-will-never-work eye, yet is confident that maybe he himself could do it. A diligent student with extensive car knowledge, his setups are quite serious, and he knows the car's behavior inside out. Yet that confidence leaves openings, and he is sometimes passed easily on a straight.

Display Name: フレイム キャノン
Bio: A member since the new regime, and naturally eager to conquer every area, though reportedly much of that is to impress teammate Yuki Hitomi. His parents tell him to quit cars because they are dangerous. He has not spent much on tuning, so his car is nothing to boast about; his one pride is a 10-point roll cage. His honest character shows in his driving: low on showmanship, but well known for careful line choice.

He pours passion into looks rather than driving and brags that nobody beats him at dress-up. Saying there is no way this lineup can do it, he is reluctant about the team's new goal of conquering every area. Nearly all his money goes into dress-up, so little is spent on power. Even his aero parts favor looks over practicality, though he does fit good brake pads to protect his beloved car.

Display Name: ハッピー ラビット
Bio: A female university student. Her skill is not bad, but she slows down at the slightest hint of contact. Her habit of leaning on being a woman is unpopular with other female drivers. It is said she is the one who drove the leader toward conquering every area. With good reflexes she slips cleverly between civilian cars. Her engine makes high horsepower and revs freely. Her only problem is fear: unnecessary braking in corners costs her time.

He attacks the corner-heavy Shuto with technique honed on the touge, and his car has special tuning. He looks after his car well but not his team; sub-leader Ishii seems to handle the team. Having trained on undulating passes, he takes uphill corners on grip and downhill corners in drifts. He is good at cornering with gravity's help, but surprisingly sluggish in corners on flat road.
Relationships: Leaves team matters to Manabu Ishii

Bio: A university student living in debt to tune his car. He recently wrecked his beloved car and is said to be counting down to credit-card bankruptcy. Because leader Hagiwara looks after the team poorly, he runs the team instead. His car just came back from repair and is still in rehabilitation, so he checks how the road suits the suspension as he drives, making him slow in corners. On the other hand the new engine seems good, and he pulls impressively fast on straights.

He relies on cornering technique rather than power, and loves feeling cornering G more than anything. He often visits Yokohama Chinatown on weekends and brings the members plenty of spring rolls as souvenirs. His machine is underpowered, so he sets low gear ratios to make up for the lack of torque. He waits patiently on straights and makes his move in corners, with soft suspension for tenacious cornering.

Driving a metallic silver machine, he races the Shuto with a boasted top speed of 300 km/h recorded on the Wangan sections. Vanishing in an instant and leaving only the afterglow of streetlights, he is truly a silver bullet. His weapon is that 300 km/h from a tuned engine and lightened body, but the car is so light it lacks bite and slides easily in corners, which is a cold-sweat matter.

Nickname: Air Blade of the Circular Route
Bio: He works part-time at a marine equipment maker. His car carries radar, which has saved him before, though it malfunctions often. He has recently developed astigmatism and desperately hides that he has become bad at left corners. His sky-blue car drives sharply, cutting the air; he is skilled and used to swing the lightweight body through corners nimbly. Since the astigmatism, though, shadows have begun to fall over that nimble driving.

Display Name: イエロー エンジェル
Bio: A university student in a camera club. At a friend's request from a car magazine she began photographing drifts and awoke to driving. By chance a teammate shares her surname, and she burns with rivalry toward him. Running around fields and mountains with a camera in hand gave her good eyesight and dynamic vision. Even on the Wangan's long straights she sees far ahead and can picture a perfect line weaving between civilian cars.

A music lover. In the car he listens almost exclusively to hip hop, and over 20 speakers recreate perfect sound quality and a live feel. As the volume goes up, his driving heats up too. For the perfect cabin audio he gave up lightening the body, so he suffers from weak braking and sliding in corners. Over-revving the engine would drown out the music, so his gear ratios are raised and his acceleration is dull.

He glides along in time with the jazz playing in his car. His lines are efficient and wasteless. He sometimes clashes with teammates over musical taste, but they are strongly bound by the keywords car and music. Like the leader, he gave up lightening the body for cabin audio, but has made up for it by boosting the engine. Unfortunately there was no budget left for brakes, so like the leader he lacks stopping power.

Display Name: クラシカル ブルー
Bio: A nervous, cerebral type who never stops servicing and caring for his car. He stands apart within the team but does not mind. The music in his car is classical. He complains that the Shuto's dirty air soils his car quickly. He takes precise lines with settings tailored to the course. With a low front and high rear he raises turn-in, yet stiffens the suspension hard, which he calls a connoisseur's subtlety; is it?

Display Name: 荒れ狂うコリオグラファー
Bio: After leaving a popular dance group he became active as a freelance choreographer. Running the Shuto seems to stir his imagination. He spreads the fun of driving to those around him and has drawn several acquaintances into the scene. He enjoys subduing a poorly handling machine with strength and technique. He knows his limits and does not overreach, but is easily pulled along by an opponent's pace.

An 18-year-old fresh out of driving school whose sense of rhythm got her a debut deal soon. She always plays groove music. Her fearless driving attacks the Shuto hard, and people worry she will crash someday. She dives into narrow lines and tight corners without fear and clears them by a hair every time. Skill is part of it, but luck is a big factor, so her teammates never stop worrying. Luckily she does not go very fast, so her driving is stable.

Display Name: ミッドナイト ブルー
Bio: A former car salesman. The music he plays while driving is shooting-game music. He chases Hisako Akiya of GALAXY RACERS, but her teammates always drive him off. He steps rhythmically left and right on straights because of the upbeat music. He presses throttle and brake to the rhythm, so his timing is quite unstable. His skill at slipping past civilian cars was reportedly practiced in games.

Five years ago he lost a fellow racer in an accident and the team broke up. He alone kept running as if carrying on that man's will, and before he knew it companions gathered and became a team. He attacks the Shuto to heal his heart. Driving forcefully and dangerously as though he has nothing left to lose, he revs the engine to the brink of blowing and never lifts in corners. Clearing flashy drifts a hair from the wall, he looks possessed by something.

No girlfriend in 25 years. He started driving to be popular with women but became so absorbed that his car is now his girlfriend. So caught up in driving that he has no time to find one, he is stuck in a vicious circle: a gloomy 25-year-old youth. Drifting draws attention, he figures, and drifting is the secret to popularity, so he polished nothing but drift technique. His feat of sliding sharply and stopping neatly inside the white lines at a PA has nothing to do with battles.

Display Name: ダイヤモンド ダスト
Bio: Driving that dodges cars like the wind and slips through corners betrays no trace of his dark past of aiming to be a rock musician and failing. As if trying to blow away a sad past by running, he cuts the wind and tears down straights. Setup favors top speed for straight-line pull. Running the Wangan section's long straights at speed, his car body reflects streetlight in glittering sparks, which some say looks like tears from Aikawa's soul.

Some years ago he was famous on TV as a psychic, but was called a fraud and his popularity plunged; since then he drifts between comedy shows for low fees. Watching how he dodges civilian cars, you wonder whether his precognition is real. However many civilian cars there are, he sidesteps them gracefully even at a 200 km/h speed difference, a near-divine skill. His ride height is lowered to match, though it leans slightly toward understeer.

Since losing his older brother to an incurable illness, he has kept running here in his brother's car as if possessed. The unruly machine that wouldn't listen when he started now seems to obey him. The car was tuned by his brother, featuring a setup that gets lower-geared with each upshift and a bored-out, powerful engine. Making use of engine braking that works even at high speed, he attacks corners with throttle work.

Her all-or-nothing nature made those around her wary of her. Realizing she was becoming isolated, she left her circle of friends and came to the Shuto. Since joining the team she has used that nature to aim for the top. She is thorough in both technique research and tuning. Still immature, she surprises onlookers by forcing a monster machine built from excessive tuning into submission. The tuning balance seems to be improving bit by bit.

In high school he couldn't even ride a bicycle and was ridiculed by everyone, but with burning passion and effort he reached the point of battling on the Shuto and earned his friends' respect. He still can't ride a bicycle but oddly can ride a moped. Learning that effort is always rewarded, he decided to live in this world. Overpracticing shift work gave him fatigue arthritis in his left wrist, so his shifts lag and his corner exits are extremely slow.

Display Name: ムーディー クイーン
Bio: She used to be the office idol, but now endures daily sexual harassment from her boss. Her cheerful personality turned inward. She joined track days to vent the built-up stress, but that became unsatisfying and she began running here. Her driving feels desperate: besides persistent blocking, she casually uses fierce charges and spiteful pushes. After a battle, though, she always apologizes in her heart to the opponent she took it out on.

Display Name: ☆ビジュアル ドライバー
Bio: His creed is that a racer's car visuals matter before technique, but his skill does not lag behind his looks. Ignoring technique, he eagerly recruits any driver who looks the part. Looking uncool is worse than death, and that obsession has produced miraculous technique. His counter-steering out of drifts is professional grade. He prioritizes looks, spending heavily on front and rear grilles, aero and wheels.

Display Name: コーナーブロックの五条
Bio: A longtime friend of leader Soichi Okita, he also prizes looks. He ruins the lines of those behind him and shows off his own graceful driving. His reckless blocking often earns him a shove on the rear bumper. He hates clunky rear spoilers as tacky. He fits stylish lights, grille and hood for a smart dress-up, and ironically gains weight savings and better aerodynamics.

Display Name: 首都高のシルバーアロー
Bio: A racing friend of Keigo Gojo whom he met on the internet, he joined the team on the promise that he could become part of a cool racing crew. His looks are first-rate flashy but his technique is third-rate. Believing a ringing engine note is the mark of a cool machine, he tuned the engine to rev high. He swapped in a muffler that rings and flows well, which also raised power, but he hasn't noticed the performance gain.

Having long turned down recruitment offers, he finally relented at the leader's sheer eagerness and joined. His skill is solid among the visual faction. He has a familiar shop where he does his setups. His distinctive rear spoiler is custom made. His body uses outrageous colors, pink and lemon yellow, and draws attention with its sheer visual impact. The inside is set up modestly, apparently on the advice of the shop owner.

Display Name: ウォータードリフトの芦屋
Bio: He joined the team for the love of showy driving. Any driving looks good on him; is it innate talent? He criticizes other members' blocking as lowering the dignity of battles, which has earned him the leader's glare. His smooth drifts clear corners without bleeding much speed. With strong pride in battle, he never blocks or weaves, always keeping fair, clean fights.

Display Name: ブランニュー サンダー
Bio: Weak in looks, but his masterful cornering with brakes held in caught the leader's eye and he was allowed in. He shows his true ability when corners come one after another. His technique is the team's best, and his cornering makes even the leader groan; he has the highest win rate among members. Remarkably, his speed entering and leaving a corner is almost the same. He excels in successive high-speed corners and shows overwhelming speed.

He joined the team wanting to be a cool racer. Rough around the edges, he shows eye-catching driving here and there. He strives to make the leader admit that a racer's coolness lies in technique, not looks. To bring out strength in high-speed corners, he softened the suspension for grip. His spoiler, side skirts and hood, chosen for efficiency, help aerodynamics and weight reduction.

He formed a touring-wagon team to start a revolution on the Shuto. Recently its fame has grown and he hopes for the coming of the wagon era. He invited Daisuke Makihara of TWISTER, his junior, to join but was inexplicably turned down. Though wagons are unpopular among racers, he is smitten with the C34M's fighting ability. With increased body rigidity, weight reduction and better acceleration he attacks corners hard. On weekends his wife uses the car for shopping, so he can't come to battles.

He subtly varies tire compounds not only front to rear but left to right, devising a special grip. Whether it works is unclear, but his stately driving shows greatly improved confidence in the car. Plunging into corners at once and pressing through narrow lines without hesitation come solely from believing in the car's ability. He aims for stability with the wagon's long wheelbase, but is weak in tight corners.

His technique itself is not bad, but lack of concentration causes many mistakes. A colleague of leader Yoichi Sumi, he often has his complaints heard and drinks bought for him. He dreams of advancing to the C1 Loop to use his specialty, drifting. Grip man Takashi Sugihara and drift man Toshinobu Kimishima are reportedly quite well known. Swinging the wagon's bulk in drifts is spectacular, but incomplete weight reduction and lack of rigidity cost him a lot of speed in corners.

Display Name: フルーティー バケット
Bio: Running a close-ratio transmission, he prioritizes acceleration above all, and the body is lightened to help. Because his suspension isn't dialed in, the front wheels lose grip under acceleration, which always gives him cold sweats. With the front end tending to lift, he can't step on it at corner exits, and struggles to maintain entry speed. He fits high-grip tires, yet understeer still can't be prevented.

He drives a machine with rock-hard suspension, more hobby than style. On public roads it picks up every bump and drives jarringly, but once at high speed its behavior stabilizes at once. His stiff suspension dominates high speed and he leaves opponents behind on Wangan straights, but in mid-speed battles it picks up the road's unevenness, so even on straights it wobbles side to side and understeers in corners.

He met leader Yoichi Sumi at a bar and joined the team. Nimble-fingered, he pulls money out of an empty palm for magic tricks and always startles toll booth staff. His car favors impact over performance, reflecting his character. Whenever he hears wagons aren't worth modifying, he keeps retorting that's not true and tells people to look at his car. Its wild coloring, stylish side skirts and glowing license plate are cool.

The phrase genius driver fits him perfectly. He can drift to hit an empty can on the road, a feat he didn't practice but simply found he could do. He is bitter enemies with Kenji Suzuki of TOP LEVEL. Besides the Shuto, he often enters domestic rallies. He tends to push quite forcefully on straights but corners carefully with neat lines, a complete contrast. He works at an imported-car dealership.

Display Name: シルバー スピード
Bio: She joined the team after seeing the leader's drift performance and admiring him. She considers Maki Wakabayashi of TOP LEVEL, the phantom beauty, her sworn enemy, and while she loses to her in battle she is confident she wins in looks. Setup and weight reduction suppress understeer and let her pull off clean drifts, but the engine hasn't been addressed yet, so acceleration is lacking. She compensates by getting ahead and blocking tenaciously.

His skill honed in gymkhana is no show; he displays sharp cornering. He fancies himself cool and cynical, yet dislikes being sneered at as a poser by Seiko Motoki of TOP LEVEL. His policy is normal on the outside, wild on the inside, and he stakes his life on hard tuning in hidden places. The one exception is the wheels, which he modified apparently at his girlfriend's request.

An artistic girl aiming to be a singer. In battle she screams loudly both when passing and being passed, and drives wildly. Among the members she bears no hostility toward TOP LEVEL, and is adored by Tsukiji and Ikegami. Friendly with people, her driving style is the opposite of her personality. A sore loser, she even uses quite nasty blocks. When badly outpaced in a battle she suddenly snaps and becomes demonically fast.
Relationships: Adored by Hitomi Tsukiji and Ryo Ikegami

Display Name: バトル スクラッチ
Bio: A DJ in pursuit of speed. He can't go fast without ultra-fast music. He has battled Tomio Makitoshi of TOP LEVEL many times and lost badly each time. With indomitable fighting spirit, he aims for revenge again today. To fast-tempo music he drives restlessly with small steering inputs, pumping brakes and the legendary Senna footwork. His cornering is excellent, but the car gives out before he does under such violent inputs.

As her byname suggests, a fiery-tempered woman. She noticed Akane Yamazaki of TOP LEVEL making advances on teammate Ryo Ikegami and works hard to drive her off. In front of Ikegami she plays a gentle woman. Her driving, shrieking high-pitched engine screaming through corners at speed, suits her temper perfectly. Her high-rev engine and tenacious suspension are thanks to Ryo Ikegami's help.

A salaryman at a trading company. Even when downhearted he is happy with the wheel in hand and insists on traveling by car. He is dating Akane Yamazaki of TOP LEVEL, but the teams' feud keeps them from meeting. His car, lightened to the limit, passes others easily. He drifts well too, and his close-ratio gearbox gives quick corner exits. His future dream is developing a zero-friction linear wheel, which is where his byname comes from.

Display Name: ☆タイム イズ マネー
Bio: A director at a cable TV station by trade. He never set out to build a team but found himself leader of his racing friends. He doesn't look after members but holds meetings often. His byname is his catchphrase. His tuning is very rough; at worst he goes out on course without even test driving. But he is sensitive to feel, and at the slightest abnormality or discomfort he notices it immediately and stops running.

His driving technique is fair, but he just can't memorize the roads. As a result he is a chronic latecomer, always scolded by the members. An illustrator by trade, he is good at drawing cars. The team's stickers are his design. Because he doesn't remember the roads, he tends to slow at junctions. Without that he would be quite a capable driver. He tunes in his own particular ways and tries many things, though his stubbornness sometimes holds him back.

A former sumo wrestler and chanko restaurant owner who joined the team judging the leader to be quite a good guy. His racing friends pointed out that his own body weight, not the car's, is the bottleneck, so he is currently dieting. The problem is still that weight; to compensate, his machine is lightened to the extreme. He is a pure chaser: no acceleration off the start, but he clings on tenaciously to the end, aiming to wear the opponent down.

He works at an ad agency and met leader Kamaya through work. He was once drawn to Kamaya's personal charm, but lately he doubts the team's direction and relations are strained. He is also angry at Tsuyoshi Kanzaki's sloppiness. He swings a heavy car around with a powerful engine. Cornering is easy, and with flowing steering on straights he passes civilian cars one after another. He is weak under pressure, though, and gets rattled with someone on his tail.

Display Name: ハッピー エクストリーム
Bio: Tired of the FF cars he rode for years, he bought his current car and delights in building a good machine. Until recently he belonged to RINGS but walked out, sick of the team-first mentality. His driving is unremarkable in every respect. Still, he makes no big mistakes, so he is quite strong against equals. He hasn't fully grasped FR characteristics yet but should surely improve as he gets used to it.

Display Name: アングリー プリンセス
Bio: By day an ordinary office lady; by night she appears on the Shuto to throw her daytime stress into driving. Kamaya says she'd be a good woman if only she never held a steering wheel. She dislikes Tomohiro Teruya as a nagging old man. Her driving is rough overall; her only virtue may be her forcefulness. She pays no attention at all to her surroundings, which in a way makes her strong. But she is often attacked from unexpected angles and loses.

A young racer newly emerged but steadily making a name, expected to reach the top someday. His results are strong both on the street and in competitions. He was a sports-car man but switched to sedans under Mitsuo Kurata's influence. Though he only just moved from sports car to sedan, he shows no sign of discomfort; if anything, the switch stabilized his driving. His tuning, however, is still to come.
Relationships: Switched to sedans due to Mitsuo Kurata

Display Name: ゴールド ファング
Bio: He joined the team after hearing leader Keizo Kudo's reputation. He is the very person who drew the leader into the sedan camp. An old acquaintance of Hayato Oki. His composure in any contest has won fans even outside the team. Having kept the same car for several years, he and the machine are a perfect match, and the tuning is nearly complete. He weaves through the left and right lanes to shut down the opponent's movement.

He joined the team together with Mitsuo Kurata. The Kurata-Oki combo was rumored to be the strongest among free racers, so popular that on days the KO duo ran, racers gathered at the PA from nowhere. A cautious type who uses no parts less than three years on the market. He won't use an engine in real battles until it is fully broken in. His cornering talent is genius; he plunges in with almost no braking yet rarely errs.

Display Name: サイレント センス
Bio: Originally a sports-car man, he switched readily once the leader moved to a sedan. Sports-car-faction members call him a traitor, but he doesn't care. His talent blossomed after switching to sedans. In sports-car days he tended to be thrown around by the horsepower, but in the sedan his driving settled. Still, old habits aren't fully gone, and his behavior sometimes gets unsettled in corners.

Display Name: ブルー フェニックス
Bio: A racer devoted to sports cars for over a decade. He became the leader's friend through sports cars, so he can't understand the leader's change of heart in moving to a sedan. He runs a small construction company along Kanpachi. A very capable sports-car driver, he shows that ability fully in corners. But he overrates his skill and machine and sometimes goes reckless and suffers from silly mistakes.

He belongs to an avant-garde dance troupe. Considering driving a form of expression, he aims for beautiful driving rather than winning. An acquaintance of leader Keizo Kudo since before either was known. He said he would resolutely keep driving sports cars, but lately wavers a little. High on performance, low in real combat level. Aiming for pleasant cornering rather than winning, his slides run long and his exits are late. He shows his showmanship on straights too.

Display Name: ☆スピリット クラッシャー
Bio: A former secret policeman from an Eastern European country. His Shuto battle history is surprisingly long, and he is intoxicated by it as a thrilling pastime his homeland lacks. An old acquaintance of Bruce Rickfield of TEAM ALPHA, his catchphrase is that petty driving will ruin you. His driving is summed up in one word: bold. He drives roughly with no regard for battle opponents, let alone civilian cars. Yet it is never sloppy, and his cornering is surprisingly clean.

Komaf's subordinate from his secret police days. A man who is vulgarity incarnate; he can't resist provoking any fancy car, racer or civilian alike. He throws his weight around on Komaf's authority. His vulgarity oozes into his driving, but like Komaf he is by no means low in level; he is just so forceful that it goes beyond common sense. He carries an engine that oddly revs freely.

A young man from Northern Europe. He claims to come from a noble house, but the truth is unknown. He secretly despises Komaf and Holonel as beasts, yet is no less dirty in his driving. He delights in utterly crushing opponents. Compared with Komaf and Holonel his driving is several notches more decent, but he deliberately provokes opponents and treats civilian cars like pawns, which is truly villainous. He reportedly uses very high-end coilovers.
Relationships: Despises Erix Komaf and Com Holonel

Display Name: マッド ドライバー
Real Name: カイン・ゲーティスト
Bio: A zero-class racer whose vulgarity makes even Holonel frown. He uses any dirty trick to win. Even Komaf seems to be unable to handle him. From the United States, madness reportedly oozes from his looks and driving. Flashy lane changes and sudden braking that chills opponents are nothing but mad driving. He swings a high-power machine around with no consideration for others. Low body rigidity is his Achilles heel.

Display Name: ドライビング サー
Bio: He is said to have been knighted in his native Britain, but his rough driving casts doubt. Without Nihael's airs, he is well liked by Komaf. He flies into a rage at the slightest scratch to his body. A ruthless driver, some have reportedly left the racing world after battling him. He even runs into opponents himself and then picks quarrels, acts bordering on crime. He has totaled seven cars.

At first glance a genial old guy, but in battle he turns into a completely different man. Yet he is utterly servile to anyone stronger than himself. A sworn enemy of John Howard of TEAM ALPHA. From the United States. He irritates opponents with excessive blocking and pulls away when they lose composure. Otherwise his driving has no standout features. He widens the body further with over-fenders to strengthen his blocking.

Characterized by thorough coldness and dangerous driving, enough that DOUBLE MIND has scouted him. But the stage of Japanese public roads seems too small to show his full ability. From Britain. His driving is never skillful, but its thoughtlessness is itself a lump of terror. Contact with battle opponents is a given. He even pulls alongside civilian cars with a gap under 1 cm, and even weaponizes his high beams.

His 86 has special tuning, and he is always looking for worthy battle opponents. He is strongly bound by a shared love of the 86 to Tetsu Kobayakawa of ROLLING GUY and Manabu Ishii of DIAMOND IMAGE. A full drift man. He uses varied techniques such as shift lock and feint motions. Uninterested in tuning, he leaves maintenance mostly to others. His setup isn't working out, and the car's true performance has not been drawn out yet.
Relationships: Bonded with Tetsu Kobayakawa and Manabu Ishii

Display Name: ストリート ダンサー
Bio: His win rate on the touge was over 80 percent, but here it is low. To avoid losing straight-line contests he modifies the car toward power, but it isn't finished. With Honjo's help he applied an ultimate setup: low first, high middle, low top again, hoping for brisk low-speed acceleration and engine braking that works at high speed. He plans to settle battles in fifth gear.

A bartender by trade. He handles the car like a shaker. He started coming to race more often and tried to balance both, but seems to be changing to a daytime job. He doesn't get along with Shuichi Takizawa and often rivals him. Strut bars and stabilizers front and rear raise chassis rigidity, plus a high-performance brake system. With brake balance heavily to the rear, he swings the car around in big drifts like a shaker.

Quiet, he thinks about driving theoretically. He never skips image training via computer simulation. Based on collected data and his own theories, he applied what he calls an ultimate setup to Takizawa's car. He handles all of the team's computer matters. Despite his diligent effort his skill isn't great, and even running with members he barely keeps up on machine performance. A safe grip-style driver, confident in quick corner exits.

A reckless racer who doesn't know how to lift off the throttle. He has crashed several times. He is flat-out buddies with Akihiro Fukui of FREE WAY, competing over who can set the higher top speed. His catchphrase is just 1 km/h faster. His top-speed setup lacks acceleration, so first through third are set low. Pulling to the high-set fourth is hard, but he boosts engine torque to force the upshift through.

He used to live by economical driving and never went above 5000 rpm, but after changing cars he is intoxicated by the engine sound at high revs. He found that some engines liven up and gain torque when revved. With a rev-it-hard setup, the final drive is set extremely low. On Wangan straights he struggles as top speed doesn't extend, but on the Daiba and Fukagawa routes he flattens fifth gear and rushes out at speed.

He admired his racer older brother and entered this world. He deliberately left his brother in Osaka to run in Tokyo, to shed his dependence. A hard-core Kansai loyalist who hates Kanto people faking Kansai dialect more than natto. He is fanatical about brakes. His driving emphasizes braking, and the 19-year-old insists that black marks drawn on the asphalt canvas are the truth of his driving.

People worried she would retire from the Shuto on marriage, but her husband apparently understands. She still has dyed brown hair but insists she's not a delinquent. After marriage she gained composure and can battle calmly. With her husband's understanding she is a force to be reckoned with. He even recommended and funded more body rigidity and safety. Repainted in her husband's favorite shocking pink, she takes on battles with unhesitating driving.

Only two years of driving, but her skill is considerable. She has begun to master Shuto driving, and her boldness is the best on the team. She acts tough to Higashi, who treats her like a child, but understands her concern. She is very particular about the interior, but tuning for speed seems to come second. Many of her setups make little sense, like excess camber for a drift spec or suspension needlessly soft.

Display Name: ムーンライト チャイルド
Bio: Normally quiet, she doesn't look like she battles. When the moonlight begins to shine she suddenly appears on the Shuto, driving innocently as if a child were at the wheel. She enjoys driving from the heart, so she doesn't care much about winning or losing. She fits large-diameter wide tires. The car has heavy camber for a full drift spec, but what matters to her is how satisfying her driving was.

Display Name: カウボーイ ガール
Bio: Theater troupe by day, part-time job from evening, and the Shuto at night. She isn't fast, but tenacity and a strong drive to win give her a high win rate. Her machine, tuned with plenty of money, has more power than she can handle. With a bored-out engine and drivetrain tuning to put the power on the road, it boasts acceleration that lifts the nose and solid grip, but in corners the power overwhelms her.

Display Name: シルバー インパクト
Bio: Active in team matters beyond driving, she works hard as the coordinator. Meticulous by nature, she aims for wasteless driving. She trusts leader Mori from the heart and dotes on the younger Koizumi like a little sister. With technique from ample experience she handles both drift and grip competently.
