She cherishes her car, saying she had no luck with men but did with cars. Gentle by nature, she never blocks an opponent's line.
Relationships: Treats Shoko Koizumi like a sister

Bio: An office lady who flies down the road wiping away tears every time she gets her heart broken. Surprisingly her technique is real, but driving in a desperate mood sends her machine wandering left and right. If she could stay calm and show that skill she would be among the fastest on the team. She weaves on straights but isn't blocking. Her concentration sometimes snaps and she slams into an opponent's rear in corners. Hard to pass if she's ahead, and dangerous on your tail.

A factory racer for a certain shop who prefers compact cars. Only he knows why he runs here at such risk. Members are split into technique and tuning factions, but he tacitly allows it, believing they will get faster by spurring each other on. He hates drifting and makes the team strictly observe a no-drift rule, yet he himself was once a drifter called a master. Now he is an acceleration-focused lead-and-escape type, and his fierce blocking never lets opponents ahead.

A former corporate-league basketball player. His quick weaving through civilian cars evokes basketball dribbling. His byname comes from a famous basketball player's superplay that amazed the world. He once belonged to a hardcore drift team but has high skill in grip driving too. He is poor at taking a win from a leading opponent, so he plays lead-and-escape, but car weight drags him and he can't post the results he wants.

He recently awoke to driving and attacks only the Shuto. He runs over 300 km every day, so gas and tire costs are heavy, but he doesn't seem to mind. Each day he runs carefully to feel the car's behavior, then returns to refine the tuning. Since coming to the Shuto he hasn't been working or even sleeping properly, so his driving sometimes wobbles, which is dangerous. He often scrapes the body in corners, and repair costs are a burden.

He has driving skill, but his hesitation at critical moments keeps him from dodging civilian cars well and he loses battles. He understands the importance of tuning but has no money, so he tries to get faster by honing skill first. His driving, unafraid of accidents, draws the members' attention. Quite skilled at both grip and drift, but weight reduction hasn't kept up, leaving a problem with corner exits. He is frantically raising funds for lightening.

He debuted late, so his driving is still soft. Yet he sometimes shows tight driving, and if the inconsistency goes away he should be quite strong. He sharpens his skills with teammate Toshiki Rukawa as a good competing rival. He likes letting the opponent go ahead and then closing in from behind, applying pressure. His driving is rough, but he exploits openings with bold lines no ordinary person would consider. He is by nature not a drifter.

Display Name: スライド フリーク
Bio: A year already since moving to Tokyo. Bad at remembering roads, he still often exits the Shuto by mistake. Since the leader banned drifting, he changed direction to getting faster through tuning. Besides grip driving, he is a two-sword man who can perform three kinds of drift (power, brake and accelerator), and sometimes secretly breaks team rules to show off drifting. He likes provoking opponents into mistakes.
Relationships: Picks up girls with Koji Takae

Bio: He spends money on his car but is starting to feel various dissatisfactions with its performance. Spending too much on the car left nothing for fashion, so he has been without a girlfriend for a long time. He often goes out picking up girls with Noriaki Higashi. He can't drift, nor even drive grip properly. But he has spent freely on tuning, so machine power helps him; weight reduction hasn't kept up, leaving torque per weight unsatisfying.
Relationships: Picks up girls with Noriaki Higashi

Nickname: Unstoppable Dream of the Black Dragon
Bio: He once disbanded the team, but despairing of a society where nothing is visible, he returned to the Shuto. Finding his place in the simple rules that are everything here, he kept running desperately and his old companions gathered again. His driving looks somewhat reckless, but it is calculated. He enters corners at speed and clears them with brake drifts. Front and rear tire grip are also deliberately varied, so his drift technique seems highly polished.

On the touge a Rina whirlwind arose from her driving and cuteness; will one rise here too? She likes the leader and was first to return when the team reformed. She brought in Taku Ishii, whom she met at Sankyo, but he has a poor reputation. The car is still touge spec and high-speed fights are hard, but the up-and-down high-speed corners of Daiba and Fukagawa resemble touge, so it's no hindrance. She hates scratching the car, so she never blocks or charges.

He used to do zero-yon drag racing. He moved his stage to the Shuto aiming for the top. His drag-racer-style aero tuning and dress-up draw snickers from members. He fell for Rina and dislikes Taku Ishii, whom she scouted. He fits large aero parts, and the machine's looks are quite vulgar. The inside is modified too, but his technique falls short and the car is too much for him. His wobbly steering is eerie and pressures opponents.

A veteran racer from long ago. He has run here in many cars, but his current car must suit him, as he has kept it seven years. He worries that the newcomer Ishii's arrival has begun to put a small crack in the team. He holds that a machine turns by air, not the steering wheel, and his aero tuning is perfect from bumper and skirt to hood and spoiler. He also uses a rear-up setup, pressing the nose down and raising the tail.

He works at a gas station and has become important as the pit man who maintains members' machines. He adapts his driving to a stock machine with the best setup he can, but the lack of tuning is painful. His determination to become a fast racer comes through, but with no money for tuning even the other members are helpless. For the time being he has no choice but to keep running the car as is while working part-time.

He apparently used to attack the Shuto in a kei car. He tends to rev the throttle a lot; fast on straights but weak in corners. A late-night worker, but since he began running the Shuto he finds it hard to balance both and rarely comes. His engine is a full high-revving type, yet he still revs it. His buzzing approach from behind seems to pressure opponents a lot, and lately he switched to a chaser tactic.

Display Name: ダンシング チェイサー
Bio: He was blasting around Sankyo when Rina Kawahara invited him to the team. Coming from Sankyo, the cheapest toll road in Japan, he grumbles about Shuto tolls, but being smitten with Rina at first sight he can put up with it. Unlike mild Sankyo, he is eager to conquer the corner-rich Shuto. His corner setup changes are still being researched, so he is especially weak around Mukojima. Large steering play slows his handling.

He left many good results in the rally world, but awoke to fighting people rather than nature. He feuds with Naoto Obata of ANOTHER STAR, but knowing he is faster, he feels at ease. His rally-honed technique is real and he masters even a machine he drives for the first time. His car prioritizes engine strengthening and weight reduction. With a normal-position setup he drives naturally with great depth.

A lively junior college student with no car of her own who secretly borrows her boyfriend's car to attack the Shuto. She can't beat Yoko Uehara of ANOTHER STAR in driving but thinks she wins in beauty, so her attitude is big. She can't modify his car at will, so tuning is left entirely to him. Asked for a birthday present, she answered brand-new tires and surprised him. Sometimes she is shocked to find the setup changed without her knowing.
Relationships: Rivals Yoko Uehara (ANOTHER STAR); Borrows boyfriend's car

Bio: Ever since losing her lover on the Shuto she keeps running to learn what he was seeking. She is indignant at Koji Miura of ANOTHER STAR calling her annoying, intoxicated by tragedy. With quick steering she changes the car's behavior constantly. She can't distinguish obstruction from blocking and sometimes puts battle opponents in danger, for which Suzuki often scolds her.

He left decent results in rally, and the next stage is the Shuto. He came to challenge racers who are full of themselves. He is neutral about the conflict with ANOTHER STAR and watches quietly if the strife leads to improvement. He doesn't press for fights but slips into the opponent's slipstream and applies pressure gradually. His tactic of bumping an opponent mid-corner to make them lose control is vicious, but he means it as a light prank.

His lap times don't change under any conditions. He excels at threading through, and gets hotter with more traffic. Go Fujiike of ANOTHER STAR sees him as a rival, but technically the levels differ entirely, so he pays him no mind. Sneering at young people who slam the brakes like a switch, he moves the car with natural rhythm, fusing person and car. He knows that is more fun and faster than straining.

Display Name: ミッドナイト スルー
Bio: With technique honed on snow roads, she calmly controls the car in any attitude. Her weak finishing may stem from her tearful nature. She actively supports the relationship between Ryo Ikegami of ANOTHER STAR and Akane Yamazaki. Rough driving brings the satisfaction of conquering a car but never speed. After learning that even rally's apparent violence rests on the driver's gentle basic motions, she became fast as if freed from a spell.
Relationships: Supports Ryo Ikegami and Akane Yamazaki

Display Name: ロシアンブルーのアカネ
Bio: Rumored to be a girl from a good family, she gives her new car luxurious tuning and doesn't forget dress-up that makes it look cute. She is dating Ryo Ikegami of ANOTHER STAR, but the road ahead looks rough. She drives by trial and error, yet with wild instinct perfectly reads the grip point. She is weak at deep corners like Hakozaki JCT on the Mukojima route, swelling wide and sometimes scraping the wall.

In top speed he is among the top five on the Shuto. His machine is heavily tuned and boasts high combat strength. His technique is above average and he wins over 80 percent of battles. Members gathered in numbers, smitten with the leader's ability. Fully tuned as if for racing, he has the team's best top speed on long Wangan straights, but he has not tuned the brakes since they add weight. His machine that can't stop is like a falling comet.

He switched to this car for straight-line speed. He still builds a flashy-looking car as before, but his motto is strategic driving. He left ROLLING GUY in what amounted to betrayal, so relations are bad. Giving up on fights on the Mukojima and Fukagawa routes, he stakes everything on the high-speed course from Wangan to Daiba. Speed-focused setup with the car thoroughly lowered. Downforce comes only from a huge, tasteless rear spoiler.

Display Name: シルバー フォックス
Bio: He runs so as to stay out of the opponent's view, like a stalker. He often blinded opponents by flashing from tail-to-nose range, but stopped after using it in a corner and causing an accident. His acceleration is weak, but he raises top speed slowly over time, so he often ends up glued to the tail unnoticed. Believing he'll catch up eventually, he never loses fighting spirit even when pulled away somewhat.

He left the Shuto for a while to hone his skills on the circuit, and has returned full of fighting spirit. Compared with the circuit, he is fed up with the Shuto's poorly paved surface and hurriedly restored his lowered ride height to normal. When he has room he passes civilian cars with light high steps at paper-thin gaps. Without civilian cars to avoid he won't change lanes until the last moment, then suddenly slides sideways, startling his opponent.

He left the Shuto once but couldn't forget driving and came back last year. Having not run for a while, he was left well behind in technique, but his driving feel is gradually returning and he is nearing the leader's speed. He believes smoothness is what matters in cornering, so he turns the steering slowly from before the corner to draw out tire grip. He rejects forcibly changing the car's attitude as the height of heresy.

Display Name: アルティメット キラー
Bio: Disliked by all for dangerous squeezing, forceful cut-ins and bad manners. Teammate Mikimoto criticizes him for going too far, but he is beaten in both tuning and technique, so he listens in silence for now. His driving is rough, yet his cornering is surprisingly razor-edge limit driving, clearing corners at speeds that seem unthinkable. On straights he keeps full throttle, and drawing other cars into trouble does not seem to bother him.

Display Name: クリスタル ナイツ
Bio: He aims to be the Shuto's champ with natural sense. Though the team's creed is bold driving backed by big power, he finds Tobiyama's vicious driving intolerable and often voices his opinion, unheeded. His stable driving has no weak points. His composure in keeping the same driving style on any course damages opponents psychologically and induces mistakes. His transparent light-blue body is famous on the late-night Shuto.

Display Name: アクセル ジャンキー
Bio: A car lover who works at an auto parts store. With frequent sudden starts and sudden braking, nobody reportedly wants to ride shotgun. He is flat-out buddies with Kazuo Nikaido of R.GANGS, both possessed by the allure of speed. He slams the brakes, then releases and whips the steering. He aims for crisp driving: finish braking before the corner, give quick steering angle, and step firmly on the throttle at exit.

Display Name: ハイウェイ ボンバー
Bio: Younger brother of Takaki Wada of MAX RACING. Thanks to his brother providing the family a 4-door sedan, he can safely drive a sports-type car. He always prefers fair fights but is also a sore loser. He aims for steady driving and doesn't take reckless risks that lead to crashes. Instead, a well-built high-power engine and accurate lines make his speed stand out. The suspension still has many unfinished parts.

A construction scaffolder by trade. Earnest by nature and strict about manners, yet well-liked by young racers for looking after them. He always clamps a cigarette in his mouth when running and lights it after winning a battle, a habit. Being strict about manners, he never drives recklessly, and picks spots with few civilian cars to make his pass. His machine is full racing spec, but he watches the noise when driving through the city.

Display Name: ミッドナイト ホークス
Bio: A 28-year-old who works at an ad agency. A scream-machine maniac whose sense of speed is warped, so he feels no fear at any speed. He goes at tremendous speed, yet says he likes to drive leisurely. He clears tight corners at considerable speed, so his setup emphasizes turning. His straight-line speed is also beyond common sense. The problem is thin low-speed torque and slow acceleration.

A 24-year-old who went three years without a win, was picked up by the leader, and is steadily growing. He lives on delivery part-time work and does street live shows in the station plaza on weekends. He likes to fit parts nobody else tries. That leads to many failures, but he occasionally hits a winner, so don't let your guard down. In driving he is overwhelmingly good only at right-hand curves, and as slow as a different person in left-hand ones.

He loves the Shuto on rainy days. He can't show his true ability when the road is dry. He actually drives a nursery school bus and is popular with the children. A disciple of Ranma Akashi, Streamer of the Storm, he shows wasteless driving inherited from his master. Lately he has apparently been preparing tires that lose grip like in rain even on sunny days, though it doesn't seem to help much. He is very nervous about danger.

Display Name: ミスター マックス
Bio: A hot-blooded driver who pushes the machine to its limit. He doesn't know the word restraint and always drives flat out. As a result he often blows engines, and owes a large debt to teammate Yusuke Kimura for the repair costs. With a long FF history, he knows FF weaknesses and strengths thoroughly. His engine trouble rate is among the top five of Shuto racers. Of course, when he is in form he is quite fast.

Display Name: ミスター マッスル
Bio: His whole body is tremendously muscular and he doesn't mind G-force at all. A pity that the car's performance can't keep up. He runs a sports shop and is a fanatical J-League fan; sometimes he skips track days to go cheer. A racer who forces the car into submission with strength, his tenacity in corners is first-rate. The suspension is reinforced to withstand that. But some issues with body rigidity remain, and fixing them would let him improve further.

Display Name: エンジェル スマイル
Bio: He runs a surf shop in Shonan. He knows many celebrities, and began driving after being invited by one. He seems to be chasing Tomonari Omiya of E.R.O., for reasons unknown. He has only recently started driving. A basic round of tuning has been done for battles, but serious preparation is yet to come. Even so, balance and reflexes honed through years of surfing are already revealing his potential as a racer.

He reportedly played wildly in his youth but has now settled as the manager of a small Italian restaurant. His experience of play seems to boost his charisma as leader. There is a rumor he has another face too. His motto is to never lose a playful spirit in any serious fight. Yet he also has tenacity to not give up even when well behind. He prides himself on free-flowing shift work and pays attention to the transmission too.

Display Name: ノンストップ エモーション
Bio: After winning a car in a sweepstakes, his best friend Obata invited him to the team and he made a nervous Shuto debut. But perhaps he had talent all along, as he is now the team's number-two. He named his beloved car Pochi and treasures it. Not the type to attack aggressively, but he drives so as to firmly hold the key moments. Watching him run, he seems to have so much in reserve you wonder if he hasn't shown his full ability yet.

Display Name: ブランニュー モーニング
Bio: He received the car when a friend was transferred overseas. Admiring racers, he asked his company senior Yukihiro Obata to get him into the team. Lately he rarely appears because of overtime. Affable, he has many friends outside the team. The engine makes alarming sounds while running, but that is a characteristic, not a fault. He built it up with his own hands over more than a year, and made most of the aero parts himself. No standout features, but solid grip driving makes him quite fast.

A racing evangelist who has drawn many people into the racing world. He works at a major construction company and yearned for the car world since elementary school. His crash count is no small number; this is his sixth machine. He easily gets carried away and is readily fooled by opponents' feints. Oddly, he shows unbelievable ability on narrow roads, and seems unable to perform on wide ones. His jet-black body melting into the dark is memorable.

A lyricist who writes words for struggling idols and enka singers. Unable to feel that he was alive, he was invited by the leader two years ago and joined the team. Sometimes lyrics come to him mid-battle and he loses. He borrows heavily from others in both driving and tuning. But he is immature in shift work and will need a little more time to catch up. He has his own particular obsession with wheels and owns a considerable number.

Display Name: センチメンタル フレイム
Bio: A rootless drifter who has already hopped between six teams. He seems to need someone on the team driving the same car as him. He is inexplicably chased by Takeshi Tamashiro of DRY CRUISE. With a long career, he drives adaptively against any type of racer. Conversely, he has no firm driving of his own. His only specialty is the pack spin turn, which of course is useless in battle.

Display Name: ストレンジ デビル
Bio: A bank employee. He tunes his beloved car with money saved bit by bit since before joining the team. A contact accident with leader Kiyoshi Sudo led to joining. Shedding his stiff daytime image, he becomes a devil here at night. Power first, power second, nothing third or fourth, transmission fifth: a full power-focused type. To fit that large-displacement engine, other areas are somewhat sacrificed. Once speed builds he is devilishly fast.

Real Name: ブルース・リックフィールド
Bio: A master sergeant in the US Navy stationed at Yokosuka. He has loved tinkering with cars since his school days. With combat experience, he has received many medals for brave actions. An old acquaintance of Komaf of HIGHWAY OUTLAW. He prioritizes straight-line stability even at the cost of some turning. Even so, his cornering is by no means slow. With an engine that accelerates smoothly from low to mid speed, he pulls away in an instant and often wins without ever being passed.

Display Name: ガトリング ジョー
Bio: A large Black officer. His wife is Japanese and the family always goes for a drive on weekends. He says he isn't very interested in battles but chases any fast car he sees. He is on bad terms with Mike Lieven and constantly clashes. Nearly all his parts are secondhand; some are reportedly rare treasures, but he uses them freely. Though rough, his driving hits the key points and oddly inspires a sense of security.

Display Name: マイク ザ・ホースマン
Bio: A fighter pilot. In the sky or on land, what he seeks is the same: thrills. For that he deliberately runs unstable tuning. He is at odds with Klein. Proud, he hates being insulted most. A hard rock maniac. He handles a peaky machine that ordinary people couldn't master without a wobble, but makes quite a few mistakes. He has tried many parts but doesn't seem to have built a machine he is satisfied with.

Real Name: ロバート・ブレスター
Bio: A fighter-plane mechanic of Native American descent. Skilled at car maintenance, he looks after all members' tuning. But he loves pranks, and the whole team has already been a victim. At first glance an ordinary sports type, but gimmicks fitting his prankster nature are rigged everywhere. His driving is decent for all that. When angry, though, he drives so roughly he can't be stopped.

Display Name: ロック スパイダー
Bio: A middle-aged bartender who works at the bar on base. A former soldier who once drove a jeep through enemy territory on the battlefield. A father figure to Bruce. A longtime archrival of Edward Miller of HIGHWAY OUTLAW. He overwhelms opponents with bold lines unimaginable for his age. Yet his behavior wobbles at corner exits, perhaps due to age. He insists on a column shifter and has had it specially modified.

A navy ensign with several real combat deployments, promoted young for his judgment. A self-described good understander of Japanese culture, he travels to Tsukiji once a month to eat sushi. On base he outranks team leader Bruce Rickfield. Not yet used to the Shuto, his driving is awkward. He firms up the suspension and other parts before the engine. His exceptional scouting ability and sense of distance draw on his battlefield experience. He is oddly fond of reverse-imported Japanese cars.

A man once called the Shuto's strongest. He recently formed a team and reappeared on the Shuto. Without his old momentum, he still has the skill to be active on the front line. Until recently he was driving a taxi. Though long retired from active racing, his technique of adaptively using drift and grip is intact. He never lets a battle opponent feel even for an instant that they might win.

Display Name: ジャイアント インパクト
Bio: An old racing friend of the leader. He too had withdrawn from the front line but joined the team on hearing the leader was returning, keeping an eye out so he doesn't go reckless. He quit his company a few years ago and now runs a bakery in Kamakura. His cornering, once called exquisite, has lost its edge, perhaps from age. Even so, he maintains cornering speeds ordinary racers never reach.

Display Name: アイアン ブロッカー
Bio: A young genius spotted by the leader and expected to be his successor someday. His novel driving style is said to be born of inspiration. On the other hand he is headstrong and rarely listens to others' advice. His driving skill is such that even the leader loses one in three. He has the technique of exploiting an opponent's blind spot to pass before they notice, but his shift work is immature.

Display Name: ジーニアス ルーキー
Bio: The leader's first disciple. Taught many techniques, he dreams of becoming a racer like the leader, but is unhappy that lately Takeaki Sakamoto gets all the affection. His byname comes from sometimes making amateur-level mistakes. Both the slightly understeering setup and the subtle quirks of his cornering faithfully inherit his master the leader's. But his technique hasn't caught up, so he is still at imitation level. He is quite strong at high speed, though.

Display Name: ウォルター ウルフ
Bio: He and the leader once saw each other as rivals. Lately he doesn't have a good impression of Takeaki Sakamoto, whom the leader dotes on, so he sides with Masanori Tsunoda. A type who practices until satisfied. To amateur eyes his greatness is hard to see, but those who know will notice every technique packed even into a single corner. Various touches can be seen in the interior too. His only weakness may be declining stamina.

A longtime racing friend of the leader who joined when the team formed. Lately, though, he isn't keen on driving. He cites age, but the real reason is thought to be that he recently took a wife 15 years his junior. Little remains of his old aggressive driving. Now he leads from low-speed acceleration and just keeps blocking, a rather passive style. When he gets serious, though, he sometimes shows glimpses of his old aggressive driving.

Display Name: ストライク スター
Bio: A bar master. He was reportedly quite a delinquent in his youth but has mellowed completely. Listening to the leader, who came as a customer, made him want to drive too. His lines are forceful but he excels at grip driving. Quite forceful driving, but because he holds down what needs holding, it doesn't look sloppy. He is poor at blocking, so he is sometimes passed easily on straights by machines with more displacement or power. His son recently became a racer too.

Both a racer and a skilled tuner. The leader lets nobody but him touch his car. At one time everyone on the Shuto admired Miyake tuning, and his bookings were reportedly full months ahead. He sees what tuning a battle opponent has and fights by exploiting its weaknesses. His tuning is quite all-round to cope with that. But his driving technique has limits.

He was originally on a team called SPEED BOX but left, sick of its low level. He launched a new team aiming for high-level driving. He hates DOUBLE MIND, who wrote off his machine. His tuning and driving are surprisingly orthodox, but in battle you are overwhelmed by his speed. His cornering sharpness is especially genius, with stability at high speed and agile response.

He is probably the only one who can casually call the leader Shu-san. First-rate as a tuner, the team's tuning is checked under his strict eye. Besides regular maintenance, he also takes tuning jobs through back channels. First-rate both as tuner and driver. In driving as in tuning he shows originality, even stimulating Kitakata. But he also has a dangerous side where he becomes oblivious to everything around him when absorbed.

A quiet man but one of principle, loved by everyone. While insisting he never bowed to Shuhei Kitakata, he secretly seems to revere him. After a close friend went missing long ago, he reportedly became withdrawn. He drives an obviously dangerous machine. In fact the tuning largely ignores safety; so far most crashes have been self-inflicted, but thanks to his outstanding driving it would be no surprise if a disaster happened anytime.

Before he knew it he had become a member, so he lacks a member's sense of belonging. Yet he seems to feel an affinity for teammate Yoshiyuki Tanba, and is often seen running right beside him. He turns his machine into a monster in competition with other members. But with little technique, his danger level is top class, and teammates avoid even running with him. Lately, though, he has begun to know his place.

His byname comes from his rugged face and huge body. He recently passed a pro-driver test and agonizes over whether to go to the circuit or keep running public roads. He joined the team feeling a debt to the leader for past help. His driving is of a high enough level that passing the pro test makes sense. Yet his hidden ferocity shows at unexpected moments. His dawn high-speed chases in particular are back-to-back with death, as if he would accelerate without end.

Though now just a team member, he was once so capable that people said Kutani rules the Wangan. The team's oldest, he is often asked for opinions by the leader. His unique drift driving, popularly called the Kutani Approach, produced many followers. But no racer can corner at Kutani's own speed. Only the machine's top speed has dropped slightly.

Display Name: スリーピング ケイ
Bio: He met the leader while working part-time at SS and jumped into the team. He has decided to follow the leader for life. He loves sleeping above all and drops off anywhere, but is wide awake when running the Shuto. He is dexterous enough to absorb any driving style into his own at once. His danger level is low compared with other members, but his installed sports ROM is said to bring out limitless acceleration.

Heir to the Soramidera conglomerate, with overwhelming driving technique. He has a philosophy of his own driving and values data over instinct. His vast data store is reportedly under tight guard. Also famous for being cold to team members. His data-based driving has virtually no openings, and natural technique backs it up further. He drives stably at any speed but seems especially good at mid-speed battles.

Display Name: コーナリング アーティスト
Bio: Second son of the Soramidera brothers. In contrast to his brother's theoretical driving he handles the car by feel. His genius driving sense is renowned inside and outside the team. His personality also contrasts with his brother's: friendly, often advising members. Compared with his brother Toshihiko he is somewhat rough, but that arguably lends flavor. Gently sliding the tires through long, gentle corners at decent speed captivates even battle opponents.

A self-proclaimed drift master. His tires wear so fast that he always keeps several sets and swaps them at the PA. Dissatisfied with the current leader, he hopes to install younger brother Shunji as new leader. Befitting a self-proclaimed drift master, his drift skill is high. Blocking an opponent's path with a drift to check them is especially remarkable. Unfortunately he can't show his full ability where there are many civilian cars.

The vocalist of a visual-kei indie band. His sense of rhythm shows in his driving. In contrast to the driver's looks the car is plain. He stands apart in the team but is overwhelmingly trusted by the leader. His driving is rather gambler-like, but that may look fresh to the leader's eyes. Various calculations seem to work in him without his awareness, and he never makes the same mistake twice.

A former racer with amnesia. Picked up by the leader while running alone, he feels indebted. He bristled on learning Yasuhiko Fujisaki wants to make Shunji leader. He keeps running today to recover his memory. His racer's instincts seem remembered by his body even without memory, and he shows very high-level driving. But perhaps due to some trauma, his shift from fourth to fifth tends to lag.

Display Name: リスキー キャット
Bio: Girlfriend of leader Toshihiko Soramidera. But lately there are rumors she is trying to switch to his younger brother Shunji. A moody type with day-to-day swings; fast when in the groove but unable to sustain it. Mental training is her task ahead. She handles the machine deftly but mood swings drag her down. Because the car was bought for her by someone else, her attachment to it is weak. Her flaws show plainly in successive corners.

He shows delicate car control with nimble steering. He used to be among the Shuto's top five drivers but has been in a slump lately. His byname comes from his high-pitched engine note and a legend of his hometown. To fit his large frame the car is also large. He can't even install a roll bar, so body rigidity is low. But when the body wavers from a mishap, he instantly recovers with his natural steering.

Display Name: ハイスピード スター
Bio: A cousin of the Soramidera brothers. A craftsman-type racer who keeps running for hours until satisfied with his driving. He actively helps collect the leader's data, though a rumor says he leaks it elsewhere. His technique is by no means low, but he drives under quite harsh conditions for data gathering. With the weight of the data collection equipment, setting a best time is nearly impossible. He is fast when running privately.

He runs a popular Chinese restaurant in Yokohama's Chinatown. His lavishly funded tuning and flashy exterior catch the eye. He often battles TEAM ALPHA's crew on the Wangan. He drives a nearly racing-spec full-tune machine. Rumor says the engine alone cost over ten million yen. And he masters that high-performance machine almost perfectly. He is practically invincible on straight courses.

Head chef at the leader's Chinese restaurant. Like his cooking, he drives with good tempo. His maxim: Steering is like stir-frying fried rice! He sometimes goes shopping in a flashily tuned car. Famous for demonic shift work and steering. His masterful lines in successive corners are so refined that members of other teams film them to study. His straight-line fighting strength is by no means low.

A master at a kung fu school in the city. His driving is just like kung fu. Wasteless, with flowing, water-like steering: you see 4,000 years of Chinese history! He often wears a martial arts uniform when driving. He never lets his guard down no matter how far ahead. He burns hotter where civilian cars are many and chooses times with relatively heavy traffic. Always serious, but not averse to showy driving.

A young entrepreneur in the trading business. His cheerful, open nature is loved by Chinese and Japanese alike. Besides cars he owns a boat and even a private plane. The car has thorough tuning you'd never guess from its looks. He always surges from the brink of defeat and wins while the opponent is still astonished. One theory says he deliberately holds back to lull opponents. The car's exterior is kept nearly stock just to lower enemy guard.

An international student. His future dream is to found a software company in his homeland. He has driven since age 15, so his career is long but his temper short. He works part-time at the trading company of teammate He Jiawei. He cherishes his car so he doesn't go reckless. The machine is tuned to show full ability on straights, so turning is largely sacrificed and he is weak where corners are continuous.

The master of Xiangxian, a Chinese pub in Shinjuku. He is reportedly a twenty-year friend of a certain Japanese F1 driver. Quiet, but his eyes shine with an uncommon light. With a busy schedule he rarely comes to the Shuto, but never neglects polishing his car. He is careful about the body, so he corners with relative margin and lifts off before reaching uncontrollable speed on straights. Fearing scrapes, he sets ride height high and washes the car twice a day.

In charge of accounting at the leader's Chinese restaurant. With a fine sense of money, he sources ultra-cheap parts from who knows where for his tuning. He sometimes gets stuck with junk and fumes, but that seems fun too. For tuning built from secondhand parts the machine is quite comfortable, with faultless engine revving and sharp cornering. But he loses a lot of time with unnecessary braking just before corners.

Details of the turbo controlled by a GTR CPU are unknown, but his driving using overwhelming power, brakes and chassis is already legend. Few know his true face; shrouded in mystery, encounters are very rare. The best engine with the strongest tuning and a thoroughly modified transmission. The boost pressure turned up for all it's worth damages the body badly, so he always aims for a short decisive fight.

Despite being only 27, he is one of the Abflug management crowned fastest on the Wangan. He handles the R34 like his own limbs, with cool judgment and unrelenting spirit, leaving no openings. Excels at bumper pushes and shoulder running. Fearless, he slips through narrow lines and shoulders at tremendous speed, so once he is ahead he is very hard to predict and counter. He applies pressure from behind with bumper pushes, which is frightening.

He drives a fully tuned 2.9-liter RB26. One of the Wangan's fastest, he keeps accelerating an R32 body that is outgunned on power through sheer willpower. With a busy schedule, chances to encounter him are scarce, and if you do you will be reduced to a dot. The rock-hard suspension raises the machine's limit high but narrows the control range. Controlling such a difficult machine without a slip shows truly first-rate technique.

On top of the A80 RZM, whose body shape is the most advantageous for top speed, he further strengthens the 2JZ, the strongest engine in the country. Once speed builds, even a fully tuned R has trouble catching him. The rear GT wing is the marker. With a stiff front and soft rear setup he tends to push understeer, but he suppresses roll in high-speed corners so he can raise speed. The speed that builds as a battle drags on is a threat.

The most unhinged pilot on this team. Stock exterior, but his driving using every bit of power is spectacular. Once he gets ahead he is a tough opponent who uses his specialty, lane blocking. The marker is the Abflug sticker on the window. He has invested heavily in transmission and suspension. For his lane blocks he has quickened steering response. His dangerous style frightens battle opponents, but he fights with a blank mind and means no harm.

Unable to stand DOUBLE MIND's rise, he gathered racing friends and formed a team. That is only the official reason; in truth he plans to make a name by beating DOUBLE MIND. He drives confidently, especially boldly in corners. His hobby is clearing corners side by side and passing in one go. His tuning has no gaps and is strong in both short and long fights.

He joined the team, moved by the leader's resolve. He believes the leader wants to beat DOUBLE MIND because he loves the Shuto. The rule that women can't join the team was made by him. His steady driving is impressive. He has a strong will to win by his own ability without waiting for the opponent's mistakes, so his tuning is offensive in style. He never falls for traps opponents set.

He took RINGS' entrance exam and was crushed, and was torn apart in the review. He hones his skill on this team to show up the RINGS crowd. Unable to warm to the other members, he often runs alone. He reportedly has over 100 strategies in his head. His adaptive, ever-changing driving makes that claim seem not entirely false. No trick works on him.

She slipped into the team disguised as a man. Indignant at being thought of as weak because she is a woman, she holds the ambition to beat DOUBLE MIND to prove women can do it. A tea ceremony master. With exquisite throttle work and braking she clears successive corners lightly. She is also bold, and her driving gives no hint that the driver is a woman. She becomes emotional when looked down on.

Second-rate as a racer but first-rate as a pickup artist. He accepts the team's purpose because he wants to be popular with women. To avoid trouble with women he chose a women-barred team, but suspects Sakae Toyohashi is a woman. He likes showy driving. A show-off, he drifts even where unnecessary. But that is just entertainment and he hasn't lost his attitude toward battle, supposedly.
Relationships: Suspects Sakae Toyohashi is a woman

Bio: The nicest man on the team. Though this team bars women, he saw through Sakae Toyohashi being a woman at once and keeps quiet. He also feels a little sympathy for her stubbornness. His hobbies are cars and mountain climbing. Perhaps too kind, he considers the danger to battle opponents and civilian cars and sometimes lets himself be passed in corners on purpose. He never makes sudden lane changes. On wide, open courses with many lanes, though, he shows a fighting instinct like a different person.
Relationships: Knows Sakae Toyohashi is a woman

Bio: He left the team for half a year and recently returned. Rumor says he wandered the country seeking faster rivals. By trade he is the founder of a ramen chain. Before his tour he told his staff he was going to find the legendary soup. His boast is having tried every drivetrain: 4WD, FF, FR, MR and RR. In the end he settled on the 4WD car he first drove.

No girlfriend in 26 years. His best friend Shu Fukaya filled his head with the idea that becoming a racer would make him popular, and he joined the team. A competitive swimmer with National Sports Festival experience. In hot weather he sometimes drives in swim trunks. He shows uncanny sharpness inside tunnels, whether grounded in anything or just mood is unknown. The exterior is barely modified, but he shows subtle fussiness over aluminum wheel nuts.

The most vicious driver in history, who has built several teams, all of which broke up because of his violent driving. Even if they are team members, in battle he thinks only of crashing the opponent. When he has room he weaves through the gaps between civilian cars in the same lane. His lane changes are always razor-thin. Seeing his wild driving, most drivers would shrink back in fear.

Display Name: カッショクノ マオウ
Bio: He is content for now as the team's vice leader, but with his strong ambition he can hardly be satisfied. He bides his time for his chance to be leader someday. He pours his energy into flaunting his own ability rather than winning battles. His flashy appearance reflects this. Racers who care for their own safety reportedly blend into civilian traffic the moment they see him.

An old acquaintance of the leader who has driven with him for years. Following the leader like a shadow, he is known as Shinjo's right-hand blade. He effectively commands the team but has no ambition. The phrase half-hearted victory is not in his dictionary. When a defeated opponent mutters that was close, that counts as a loss to him. He uses any means to avoid ending with a half-hearted victory.

Display Name: セキショクノ キョジン
Bio: A wild child of public roads who drives as instinct commands. He has no interest in the team's power struggles; as long as he is given a place to run, anyone can be leader. Tatsuya Oze, however, seems to want to bring him under his sway. In tense battles he doesn't see civilian cars at all. Only the opponent's machine is in his field of view. His body moves before he thinks, so strategy doesn't work on him.

Display Name: カッショク マジン
Bio: A young man who idolizes Tatsuya Oze. He wasn't a rough driver, but lately he is coming under Oze's influence. A 24-year-old who dropped out of a famous university and dreams of making a name in the racing world while working part-time. He is good at reading opponents' moves, and so tends to be overly caught up in them. He often falls for simple traps battle opponents set. He himself doesn't like tricks.

Display Name: ソウハクノ テンシ
Bio: After being expelled from several teams, he settled in this one, which lets him run freely. But witnessing the petty power struggles, he is already giving up and has quickly drawn close to Shuhei Kitakata of UNLIMITED. Oddly, he is unremarkable when leading but shows his strength once passed. The machine is thoroughly lightened and the setup suppresses understeer considerably.

Display Name: ハイイロノ セイレイ
Bio: He seems to drive calmly, yet drives so as to gradually corner opponents mentally, so uncanny that even leader Noriyuki Shinjo keeps his distance. Toward Masaharu Mitsui, though, he seems to sense the same smell and is friendly. His skill is not bad, but careless mistakes are many. His recoveries, though, are so good that they don't develop into much loss. Often opponents are distracted by the speed of his recovery.

A programmer who drives the Yokohane line in an FR-based 4WD. He extended ROM tuning from engine control to steering control, adding even more auxiliary equipment to the already heavy R34 RV. He is in a terrible mood the night his favorite baseball team loses. He builds a machine that can handle every condition, such as automatic front-rear brake balance by tank volume and infrared sensing of road temperature and humidity. His trust in devices over skill kills his talent.

An old friend of leader Koji Kondo. A man who easily slides a 4WD that is supposedly fast on straights but won't turn at the limit. Also called the team's party chair, he often gathers members for barbecue parties. The machine's rigidity is thoroughly raised with urethane and rivets. Besides the usual boost increase, he lowered the engine mount by moving auxiliary equipment. His weight has finally passed 100 kg and seriously affects vehicle weight.

A well-known racer on the Rokko passes who traveled to Kanto and was captivated by the Shuto. He handles full grip and inertia drift freely. With high concentration he excels at threading lines like the eye of a needle. Once ahead, he is feared as a turbo killer who uses large drift angles to draw opponents into low-speed fights. Main changes are wheels to cut unsprung weight and a multi-plate clutch.

Born the child of a car racer and trained in karts from a young age, he is a true thoroughbred. His technique of mastering any car may be innate or in the blood. Recently he settled on a JZZ30 and has just begun tuning. As soon as he appeared on the Shuto, his car-agnostic technique made him a Shuto notable in no time. Forcing his hard-to-drive, mid-tuning JZZ30 around by changing weight distribution under braking is divine skill.

Display Name: ロータリ フラワー
Bio: A rumored female college student who drives the FD, the last rotary fighter. Her parents' funds are plentiful, so her home garage holds several spare engines, and she shows up on the Shuto with whichever is in best shape that day. She even has a dedicated mechanic team. Sharp cornering is her weapon. With a fully tuned machine bought with abundant funds and always the best engine installed, she is unbeaten on the Yokohane line. The always-polished machine isn't driven on rainy days.

Display Name: ホテル オーバーレブ
Bio: A cheerful American whose overly luxurious interior earned the nickname Hotel among friends. He loves GT cars that won't turn and big-diameter speakers, and always shows unbelievable drifts on slippery American tires. Body fully FRP, engine bored out with plenty of money. Prefers a soft setup with abrupt turbo and big body roll. To an outsider, he handles nearly uncontrollable drifts perfectly.

He came to Japan secretly as a test driver for a German manufacturer to tune suspension, but fell in love with Japan and decided to settle. He is rumored to be the fastest sedan on the Yokohane line, only natural for a pro driver. Brake fade resistance is greatly strengthened and he drives in step with the power. He is careful with the suspension too, thoroughly refining works-style coilovers. The transmission is reinforced to transmit power without waste.

The team leader, but he has no awareness of it. Still, his caring, dutiful nature suits a leader. While running with friends the team formed before he knew it. His driving is plain overall, but his pull from mid-speed is notable. With highly developed dynamic vision he can read and respond to even the slightest movement instantly. His tuning is a fairly typical drift spec.

A friend who supports the somewhat unreliable leader from the shadows, or so he claims; in fact he just pushes all the troublesome chores onto the leader. A programmer at a staffing company, he goes straight from work to the Shuto, enjoys a battle, then heads home. He drives with margin. His cornering looks leisurely, which sometimes unsettles opponents. In fact he uses only about 80 percent of the machine's performance, but is still plenty fast.

A programmer at a game company. He met the leader and Takeharu Hosoda through work. The team's mood maker. To rewrite ROMs, he drives while typing on a notebook PC installed in the car. Nothing to say about the sports ROM; it is set to bring out maximum engine performance. But with the engine itself being underpowered, this may be the best he can do now.

Big talk, but a kid whose nerve is still lacking. Perhaps because he lacks confidence in his skill, he has trouble fitting in with the other members. His father belongs to TRUE RIDE, and surpassing his father is his immediate goal. In driving he is drift-oriented, the opposite of his father, but they share a weakness at blocking. His driving looks flashy but follows theory and rarely goes reckless, just like his father.

Display Name: インテリ ティーチャー
Bio: A science teacher living in Ibaraki Prefecture. He wears a lab coat instead of a driving suit. Though the team's oldest, he is humble. His scientific analysis of driving is impressive, but occasionally preachy, which is a drawback. Scientific analysis lets him spot opponents' weaknesses, but he lacks the technique to win by exploiting them. His scientific tuning, however, is perfect, and against same-class cars he reportedly wins 73 percent of the time.

As his byname suggests, known for bold driving. His aero parts are as bold as his driving. Surprisingly polite, he can follow Hirofumi Katano's theoretical talk. He is a childhood friend of teammate Kaneko and they often practice together. Many small mistakes but overall careful driving. Only in cornering does he tend to turn on willpower rather than technique. He makes up for underpowered machinery with weight reduction and a high-performance sports ROM.

A car-loving girl who just got her license but is actually the team's gutsiest. If her ability matched, she would overtake the others in an instant. She wanted to drive after riding in Kazuhiro Minagawa's car. Though she has been in danger several times, she has never been injured. She seems to have a talent for instantly avoiding crises. For a beginner she is polished, but her cornering still has a lot of waste, a task for the future.

He has long been leader but is thinking of retiring soon. A top-level Shuto racer. Many entered the racing world admiring him. Even now many racers reportedly come to him for advice. In driving he is conservative. He faithfully keeps the traditional so-called fast setups and driving techniques. He doesn't like changing machines or parts much, and as a result knows everything about them.

An old acquaintance of the leader who has run with him since the team's founding. A candidate for next leader. He feels no attraction to the leader's seat, but thinks he should run things rather than let Tetsuya Kobayashi take it. Works at a food company. Cornering isn't his forte, but he is proud that nobody beats him in straight-line speed and stability. Reducing air resistance to the limit, he has repeatedly broken the Haneda route speed record. Superb shift work.

Display Name: ビジュアル テール
Bio: A newcomer but, thanks to his high ability, in an important position in the team. He is confident he is the right next leader. But his romance is slow-paced and he can't even ask Yuka Yamamura, whom he likes, out on a date. His zero-yon-honed shift work is no show. He also sets up the engine himself, tuned to suppress turbo lag considerably. At high speed, though, the machine is somewhat inflexible and unsuited to blocking.

Display Name: サンセット ライナー
Bio: A member since the founding. Friendly with all on the team but often at odds with Okawara. He backs Tetsuya Kobayashi for next leader. Stubborn, he doesn't change his style whatever anyone says, but listens to the leader's opinion alone. His cornering, one beat behind ordinary people, often throws opponents' rhythm off and wins. It is purely his habit, but many battle opponents interpret it as strategy, and he doesn't seem inclined to correct it.

A woman as charming as her byname does not suggest. But she has somewhat wild ideas that always perplex those around her. Best friend of Rena Koyama since junior college. Many men pursue her, but for now she has no intention of getting a boyfriend. She attacks from unexpected lines and can throw battle opponents into a panic. Tuning is fairly ordinary: softer suspension, a high-performance sports ROM, and body reinforcement to withstand 350 km/h.

Display Name: パール ホワイトキス
Bio: A friend of Yuka Yamamura. Particular about setup, she is valued within the team as a tuner too. She openly says she prefers cars to men, but secretly holds feelings for the leader. Her setup sells ease of handling rather than extracting the machine's potential. Even so, combat strength is high enough. The engine, which keeps low-to-mid-speed acceleration while stretching at high speed, is exquisite.

Display Name: マニアック プレイヤー
Bio: A pianist by profession. He lives for being called eccentric. Who knows what he is thinking, he recommends Yuka Yamamura for next leader. He keeps changing cars but always finds maniacal machines. His setup is quite maniacal, with quirky gear ratios, yet handling is by no means poor. His tasteless aero parts, though, draw plenty of remarks from teammates.

Display Name: ブラック エンジェル
Bio: She is searching for her older brother, who went missing after going to run on the Shuto. Betting on her information-gathering ability, she got close to Tetsuro Akiyama. She hasn't found a clue, but realizes she is starting to genuinely like him. Her low-to-mid-speed acceleration isn't good so she is dropped at once, but once speed builds she accelerates in a rush, chilling unguarded opponents. She has experience in zero-yon competitions.

By day he works part-time doing hero shows on a department store rooftop. The coolness of a sports car he saw as a child left a strong impression and drew him to racing. He once dreamed of driving foreign sports cars but now favors domestic. His driving creed is coolness, to the point that winning means nothing without cool driving. He has plenty of technique and shows precise driving as the situation demands. He uses hard-compound tires.

Display Name: ファースト ビート
Bio: A freelance writer covering the reality of racers. Researching why they run here, he himself became captivated by driving. He sympathizes with the leader's way of life beyond mere subject matter. A large air duct cut into the hood is distinctive. High-speed stability is outstanding and he is light on his feet too. But body durability doesn't seem to keep up. His rough cornering is also a concern.

A part-timer at a gas station. Between shifts he appears on the Shuto every three days, chasing top speed. Parts broken in battle he salvages from scrapped cars to repair. Apparently he won't fight anyone who hasn't done a fair number of battles. Pursuing driving obsessed with top speed, he stakes his life on weight reduction. Suspension stiffened to prevent roll is excellent for straight-line travel, but he can't shed speed in corners and often spears into the wall.

When single his creed was fearless, combative driving, but his driving has changed since he had a child. He hides running the Shuto from his wife, so every five days under the pretext of overtime he stops by his parents' home on the way back from work and cruises in his old car. The machine, built with skill honed in his single days and top tuning, was invincible then but undeniably inferior to cars with today's technology. Out of habit of considering his wife and child he sometimes lifts off the throttle at the crucial moment.

A personal tuner dreaming of opening a tuning shop. Once a week he shows up on the Shuto to test the results of his tuning. With the ambition of building a customer base in the city, he only fights cars with Tokyo ward plates. He publishes tuning details on his own website, but traffic is low, so he sticks a sticker with the URL on the car. His skill isn't much, but a car optimized to the limit for the Shuto's surface is worth fighting.

Display Name: スピード ドランカー
Bio: A nurse who loves roller coasters. Seeking an adrenaline rush, she shows up on the Shuto night after night. She was once given a ride in the passenger seat by Miracle in Black after meeting him on the Shuto and is smitten with his driving, so she can't forgive anyone who dirties it. She has tried every tuning a shop can do, but as a hospital worker can't touch loud mufflers or flashy aero. By profession she extremely fears accidents, so contact drains her spirit.

A lone racer who associates with nobody and just runs the Shuto. Rumor says he is extremely shy, but only his sole friend, Lonely Survivor, knows the truth. Friendship might be earned through several battles. Extremely wary of people, his tactics are a typical lead-and-escape, and the machine is set up for acceleration. He dislikes long entanglements, so in a long close fight his spirit drains and he may lift off the throttle himself.

A mercenary in a foreign unit. When in Japan he can't stand peaceful life and comes to the Shuto seeking the tension of life and death. For some reason he reportedly battles only foreign cars. He plans to return to Japan in six months. Smitten with the performance of Japanese cars, he doesn't tune flashily and gets through battles on his own skill. His specialty is pushing an opponent into a wall to crash them. Having lived abroad long, he prefers driving on the left when accelerating.

A circus performer who specializes in escape acts. His nerve and reflexes are put to full use on the Shuto too. Perhaps reminiscing about the big show at Shiodome ten years ago, he is sometimes seen parked where the site is clearly visible. Acrobatic driving is his hallmark, but he never uses underhanded tricks. For him battle is purely entertainment. His tuning prioritizes ease of handling, so power is held down a bit.

Display Name: 迷走のアイドルフリーク
Bio: Working on a weekly magazine's editorial staff, he rockets around the Shuto on a weekly basis. An idol freak, he bought the car his favorite idol called cute on a TV show. He thinks everyone driving the same car is an enemy. He knows almost nothing about cars and leaves it to the shop. Lightweight aero chosen for looks and a roaring muffler happen to match the car's direction, so his top-speed run is decent.

A hugely popular idol currently breaking out. To escape frenzied fans she began driving to the studio in her tuned car. Lately she's sick of fans chasing her in cars and is looking for someone to beat them. To shake pursuers in an instant she uses an acceleration-focused setup. With no guilt about wearing out a car, she doesn't mind tuning that carries some stress. Being a popularity business, the car looks stock.

A regular who comes to run every three days. His byname comes from appearing like an illusion and vanishing an instant later. If you can keep up to a point, you may see beautiful drifts leaving a red light trail. Slipping past other cars with tuning focused on the standing start is truly divine skill. His creed is beautiful driving, so he never blocks. If hit by overly violent attacks, he sometimes throws the fight.

He lives in Sangenjaya along Shuto Route 3 and reportedly drinks three coffees before heading out. A man with an extraordinary fixation on the number three. Even when he appears he goes home after three laps, so you can't meet him unless it's a very lucky three day. Fixated on three, he sets all tuning to level three. He pulls in third gear overwhelmingly often, so his acceleration is sharp but top speed weak. In his third battle he tends to show overwhelming strength.

A man who delivers dubious videos late at night. He likes racing games and always listens to racing game soundtracks in the car. He figures that running here for about a month will make him a regular customer, so he battles to sell videos. Admiring European sports cars, he set up his car to mimic their distinctive nose-up stance. He reportedly grins at the nose popping up when viewed from the side at a parking area.

Display Name: マシン オブ インフェルノ
Bio: A man who stops at nothing to win. His violent attacks always send his car in for repair after each run, so he can only come about once every ten days. Rumor says he fights nobody but FF cars like his own. He believes FF cars are the right ones to battle on the Shuto. His setup is a top-speed type with lowered ride height and high final drive. Once he catches a wave he vanishes from sight in no time.

A philosopher who runs the Shuto to look at himself. He is apparently confused by his own self who unleashes raw fighting spirit in battle. Before battles he is sometimes seen parked on the Yaesu route, meditating. His setup is stability-focused, with comfortable suspension and high-grip tires, but his driving style is 180 degrees opposite: flashy drifting that wastes the machine's performance entirely.

The third son of a dentist. Sponging off his parents, five machines are lined up in the yard of his family home. Not confident in his skill, his only boast is owning more cars than others. To protect that pride he waits for prey again today. Acceleration and top speed are nothing special, but he puts a lot into body strength. Aiming to reduce the number of cars others own, his main tactic is hit and run. With no spine in his driving, he often loses by a hair.

Display Name: マスター ポジション
Bio: A famous pickup artist on the Shuto. He battles as a means to woo the girl in his passenger seat. He sets out after dinner and fights only luxury foreign cars. After battles he drives to Rainbow Bridge to talk of love. Since the aim is to show the passenger the battle, he enjoys a close fight to the limit and likes the pattern of passing at the very last moment. He prioritizes ride comfort, so the suspension is soft and rolls easily, a drawback.

Holder of the title Fastest in Shonan, said to be invincible on Route 134. He came to the Shuto once a week at a former senior's invitation, but vanished after Jintei appeared. Reluctant to battle, but reportedly fights Shonan plates. He flings around an all-round car, from passes to circuits, with abandon. His light footwork in successive corners makes even battle opponents want to applaud. Durability is his only weakness.

He was formerly one of the Four Heavenly Kings but crashed mid-battle, wrecked his beloved car, and lost the seat. He is now running hard to win back the Heavenly King seat, haunting the Shuto in the deepest hours to challenge those who run a lot. His driving is a death-defying bullet type, but perhaps from the fear of having once had an accident, he is thorough about body reinforcement, with top-grade roll bars and injected urethane. He sets the brakes weak and nails drifts beautifully.

A man who gave body and soul to gambling. He tends to be superstitious about everything and appears on the Shuto only on days that are lucky for him. Meeting him is so rare that some consider merely seeing him lucky. At gambling he can't quit when he should, so even when winning he often ends up losing. The same goes for driving. He occasionally wins big, but pours it all into the car so life is hard.

An office worker from Aomori. On his one weekly day off he comes to the Shuto and battles only cars with Naniwa plates. The reason is apparently that as a student on the Meishin on the way to Kobe he was mocked: I thought you were crawling, are you from Tohoku? Raised on terrain with few stop-and-go sections, his tuning is all about top speed. Overwhelmingly fast on straights but as bad as a novice at passing other cars. Unaccustomed, he fears walls and often drives in the lane center.

I only keep the rules that help me win! A Shuto outlaw. He targets only cars with very low mileage, living to challenge and crush the opponent before they master the car. His tactic is to sap the opponent's spirit with driving that induces crashes. He makes opponents sit right on his tail, then slams the brakes to get rear-ended or lure them into a junction, so his brakes are heavily reinforced.

A night flower who works in Ginza. After work she heads out to the Shuto looking for new customers. Aiming to marry up through a battle, she won't engage unless the other has a considerable sum. She knows little about machines so tuning is left entirely to others, but she cares most about looks and won't do any tuning she finds uncool. Some modifications don't match her driving direction, but she doesn't care and pushes to the limit.

Display Name: モスキート レモン
Bio: A life advisor to racers. His driving has little appeal, but his words reportedly grab the hearts of Shuto racers and won't let go. He is especially close with Red Shadow, so he tends to want to fight cars that came up in his conversation. He receives leftover parts from the racers who gather, so the parts grades are uneven. There are mismatches such as luxury wheels with cheap aero, but it doesn't seem to affect his driving.

A genuine young lady, the only daughter of a major bank's president, but sick of the arranged marriage her father pushed, she ran away from home. Reality is harsh, though, and to live she looks for rich people here, battles them and earns living expenses. The car she lavishly tuned when she lived freely at home is still at a decent level. Her driving is a typical straight-line type. She is weak in corners and often makes fatal contact.

The ride home after dropping his girlfriend off was boring, and as he pressed the throttle he began to stand out, but with no self-awareness as a racer he accepts no battles at all. He is considering switching to a two-seater and is sometimes seen following one out of interest. The machine is strictly a date spec pursuing ride comfort. Since his girlfriend sometimes drives it, it is set up to be easy to handle. Acceleration is okay but top speed lags.

A former pro baseball player who won 100 games in his career. He comes to run every three days but is proud and fights only those who have made a name around here and have more wins than himself. As a racer he is one win short of matching his playing days. His goal is powerful driving, so his cornering is rough. But his straight-line acceleration is overwhelming and ordinary cars can't catch him. Body and suspension are well prepared for high power.

An employee of a map-making company. He is currently making a complete map of the new Loop and verifies it by actually driving, so as not to be off by even 1 cm. He sometimes battles to get information from people who run constantly. Since the purpose is checking the map, his driving is careful grip style. Tuning is average to match. He doesn't mind being passed mid-battle, but tends to flare up if hit.

An active race queen. Since being given a ride beside a racer on her team, she has been captivated by speed and shows up on the Shuto to recreate that excitement. Her dream is to land a man who can fill more than half a garage with cars. The car she drives is her father's, with whom she lives. For some reason it has a boost-up and a large-capacity muffler. Its poor top-speed stability is a charm for savoring thrills.

He can reportedly tell how much tuning a car has just by hearing it run. Aiming for a winning streak, he targets only low-mileage cars and never battles cars whose tuning is audible. Being sensitive to sound himself, he figures opponents might notice if his engine and muffler sound differ from stock, so he modifies everything modestly.

Display Name: ラズベリー キッス
Bio: Her popularity soared after her face appeared in a car magazine. Many lie in wait at PAs to see her face, so lately she can only come here about once every ten days. Contrary to its flashy looks, the machine is built for handling. So she can't show full ability at crunch time, but her careful lines let her cling tenaciously even when led.

A genius mechanic and also a young master potter. He uses the Shuto once a week to transport kiln-fired works. He is currently experimenting with the allure of black and is drawn to black-bodied cars to challenge. Because he carries fragile goods, suspension and underpinnings are set soft. He tries to drive in straight lines with little lateral G, but when violent driving scratches the pottery he commits to aggressive driving.

Display Name: キューティー ヒップ
Bio: A girl aspiring to be a model. Every night she sallies onto the Shuto to captivate the men with a car body that has the same glamorous hip line as herself. She tends to appeal to rich men who might buy her an apartment. For the reason of showing off the body's curves she fits no aero at all. She makes the front-heavy car wiggle as if swinging her hips. Slow exits and no top speed to expect.

From Okinawa, he has driven through storms since just after getting his license, so he is good in bad weather. He brags that he is number one in a storm, but battles don't happen then, so his real ability is unknown. He reportedly appears when his disciple is beaten. Real storm ability unknown, but he is good at dodging obstacles blown by storms, so blocking attacks hardly work. To resist crosswinds he lowered the car to the limit with a low center of gravity.

Display Name: 不屈のアレキサンダー
Bio: He harbors the ambition of conquering the entire Shuto like the historic hero Alexander. With no chance on speed, for now he aims to be champion in mileage, and those who have driven the same car long are his immediate enemies. Since the goal is to keep his current car long, he does no strained tuning such as boost-ups. Assuming very long turns of battle, he tends to show his ability more as a fight drags on.

A man who hates anything crooked and can't rest unless everything has sharp corners. Believing triangle is his foundation, he comes to run only on days with a 3. He battles only cars from the same manufacturer as his own. His straight-line driving makes it look like he slides sideways in parallel when passing civilian cars. Aiming for cornering that cuts at acute angles like a set square, he applied top-grade tuning to tire grip and braking.

A man skilled enough that he was once even called one of the Four Heavenly Kings of the Loop. He left his team over tangled relationships and began cruising the Shuto alone. His byname seems to come from appearing only in the dead of night. Though retired from the front line, the skill that earned him the title of Four Heavenly Kings of the Loop remains. His skill reading the flow of traffic and slipping through is art. The car is nimble and acceleration-focused.

A young sushi chef who normally works at Tsukiji. His competitive streak makes him earnest and studious. He is sometimes seen parked where Showajima JCT leads onto the Wangan, waiting for opponents he can beat. He is a theorist who simulates in his head before battle and drives on that basis. Cautious, he waits in a parked car for an opponent he can beat. His weapon is active driving using lane changes skillfully.

Display Name: ジェット スケーター
Bio: A former speed skater. With a rocket start and calculated lines he weaves through the Shuto. Dreaming of a battle decided by a hundredth of a second against a rotary car, he comes every week looking for people who run a lot. His beloved car, tuned for burst and handling, is a pure acceleration-focused type. He hates losing speed more than anything, so when blocked on his calculated line his spirit tends to drop sharply.

Editor-in-chief of a third-rate gossip magazine. While chasing the legendary racer he himself became captivated by driving. He appears every three days looking for the car rumored to be driven by the legendary racer, who is strong enough to beat Jintei. His dress-up is a type popular a while ago, yet it somehow doesn't feel outdated. Engine sound is life is his catchphrase, and his high-rev engine note is indeed pleasing.

Display Name: トゥモロー アゲイン
Bio: A sound effects professional. At home he stocks vast data of car sounds, and is now collecting exhaust notes. He occasionally comes to run, trying to record in battle the sound of a car with the best muffler tuning. He is proud of his homemade sports ROM. Other setups he leaves to an acquaintance tuner, but the ROM he spends days finishing to his own taste. He excels at bewildering opponents with quirky driving.

A Shuto racer of the old days. His beloved car, which has aged along with him, breaks down and he considers replacing it each time, never quite committing. Saying he can't lose to young cars yet, he challenges low-mileage 2000-model cars. He presses the throttle gently, as if nursing it, so he mostly loses the start dash, but he is good at passing other cars and handling corners and soon catches up. With gout, he sometimes suddenly can't press the throttle.

A returnee whose American-trained wild driving is charming. To relieve stress built up from a cramped life, she shows up briefly after midnight. She apparently hopes to meet someone with a high-output car who will run with her. Having gotten her license in America, her beloved car is actually an automatic. Acceleration is dull, but knowing re-accelerating after slowing is hard, she rarely lifts and often crashes by failing to turn in corners.

His byname comes from his looks, unrelated to the car or driving. Though still a teenager, his thinning hair may make him look adult. He battles only very low-mileage cars, for reasons unknown. He puts effort into suspension rather than power. Perhaps because he worries about his hair, after hearing that moisture is bad for hair growth he always keeps the air conditioning on. But he turns it off in the clutch, so acceleration suddenly improves at times.

A second-generation gardener. He comes to run every three days and has a full grasp of the condition of the trees he sees. An ecologist, he fights big-displacement cars that spew exhaust needlessly and makes them promise never to run again. His immediate goal is to beat Black Dragon. He uses alcohol-based fuel instead of gasoline and the latest eco-type tires. He never neglects cleaning the air cleaner, upholding his ecology creed in his own car. He takes care not to plunge into trees in the median.
Relationships: Wants to beat Wang Yonghui (THUNDER DRAGOON)

Bio: A huge racer. He has tried various tuning to run faster but recently thought his own weight loss might be effective and is now dieting. A fellow big man, Lonely Survivor, who told him which full-bucket seat fit his build, is his kindred spirit. To support a heavy driver on the Shuto, the engine is an acceleration-focused mid-range high-torque type. The car is lightened to the limit and springs reinforced, but the driver is so heavy the body always leans right, so he is very weak at left corners.

His only boast is leaving driving school with no mistakes. Nobody beats his PA parking technique, though it means nothing for driving. He plans to beat people with many cars in battle and get them cheap. Like a driving-school car, his car oddly has a passenger-side mirror. His creed is textbook driving, braking precisely before corners. For lane changes or passing other cars he checks not only the mirror but also by eye.

Display Name: ストーキング ハンマー
Bio: Looking for a girlfriend who likes cars. He parks where Oi leads onto the Yokohane route and, spotting a girl's car, sticks right on it and tries to hit on her at the PA, never successfully. He apparently parks sometimes to look for battle opponents. His car has extreme lowering and a mysterious tassel hanging from the rearview mirror: a delinquent spec. No particular tuning for driving, but since pushing is his usual move, he never neglects body rigidity.

A veteran racer who has run the Shuto for over ten years. His byname comes from zero losses, and he claims to be the Shuto's fastest. You supposedly can't even meet him unless you come here a great deal. The engine is a full top-speed spec. Exits are somewhat heavy, but he doesn't seem to consider it a problem. He keeps the throttle pinned and never lifts. Perhaps because of that speed, he reportedly sometimes battles the legendary racer.

He uses his former team's name as his byname and appears about once every five days. He is trying to launch a one-make team for the car he drives. He reportedly looks for someone with the skill to beat his former members and who drives the same car. The NA2 is complete is his theory. So he does no tuning that would kill the car's inherent strengths and fights with a refined setup. The light body sometimes lifts and he loses control.

A poet and doll artist. He speaks 16 languages freely, starting with French. His career is short but he honed his technique through effort. He is occasionally seen parked where Tokai JCT leads onto the Yokohane route. Sometimes eccentric, sometimes cautious, his driving is improvised with no strategy at all. Relying on instinct alone, he can't expect constant wins, but sometimes beats unexpected opponents.

Display Name: 疾走のファンファーレ
Bio: A mother of one whose hobby is chasing visual-kei bands. Her car is of course the same car in the same color as her favorite bandsman's. Wealthy and proud, she has strong rivalry toward the super rich. With exquisite footwork braking she controls corner speed freely. The suspension is set for smooth weight transfer. But top speed is weak, so she can't show her ability on straights.

A man who loves to stand out. He enters big marathons as a general participant, and his hobby is sprinting 400 meters from the start to appear on TV. With his license suspended, he can't come to run until it's lifted. Like a marathon start dash, his driving lives on the start dash. Naturally his tuning is zero-yon spec. He likes garish aero and a flame-spitting muffler. After taking the lead he uses thorough blocking tactics to steadily aim for a win.

Display Name: ゴールド ライセンス
Bio: Though he commutes daily on the Yokohane route, he boasts a gold license with no accidents or violations since getting it. He is waiting for someone to punish nuisance drivers who say things like I only keep the rules that help me win. Having commuted by car for many years, his driving skill, especially cornering, is respectable. He started tuning with a quick shifter and body reinforcement and is now saving for engine strengthening.

Display Name: アイアン レーサー
Bio: President of Suzuyama Metal Mold Industries. On the 5th and 10th he visits clients by car and comes straight to the Shuto. He usually cruises alone without battling, but gets heated when he sees a car made around 1970. Beyond intake and exhaust he has changed tires and gear ratios, but the machine is somewhat underpowered, forcing hard battles. His tactic is to sap the opponent's strength with surprise attacks and guts.

Display Name: エキゾチック バタフライ
Bio: A clinical psychologist. Her research theme is fear and pleasure, and she reports on the experience by running the Shuto herself. Her immediate task is collecting data from those who have reached the pinnacle on the Shuto. She excels at fights that analyze the opponent's psychology. The spirited acceleration from a lightweight flywheel puts considerable pressure on opponents. But she is poor at dodging blocks, so she is weak when led.

Display Name: キング オブ エデン
