Bio: Manager of Anrakuen, a long-established hot spring inn in Hakone. He started a budget package plan so people without money can use it easily. Half business, half hobby, he crosses the Hakone passes every week to come to the Shuto. Since he drives the passes during the day for work and life, the car is a touge spec focused on torque and suspension. The aero is tastefully done, but as it's technically a company car he is debating putting the company name on the side.

A man who keeps running the Shutoko in one car he has loved for a long time. He trades information with his old-car friend Gentle Rain and appears on days containing a 3. He looks for battle opponents who truly love their cars, and never fights a car that has been tuned. To keep driving it for years, he has not forced any heavy tuning. The engine is worn, so both acceleration and top speed are poor, but he makes up the difference with ideal cornering lines and artistic weaving through traffic.

Display Name: ジェントル レイン
Bio: Still drives a car nearly 30 years old from new. Lately the body has warped and leaks rain, so he reportedly drives in a raincoat inside the car. He looks for others who have kept the same car for a long time, like himself. When the body started to sag badly he fitted a roll bar, which stiffened the chassis, and one thing led to another until he tuned the suspension too. He is sometimes thrown by the car's twitchy movements, but drives without waste, knowing its performance inside out.

An international airline pilot. Because of work he can only show up once every ten days, but he is close with the members of TEAM ALPHA. He wants to beat them and fight anyone who has exceeded 400 km/h in a battle. Having been through many troubles in the sky, he stays calm and composed at all times. The instrument panel is customized to resemble a jumbo jet cockpit. Like piloting an airliner, his driving is careful and never lets its guard down, even at low speeds.

Display Name: サイレント バーバリアン
Bio: A taciturn big man from Okinawa. Dutiful by nature, but once he starts driving he turns into an unstoppable brute. He loves his hometown, so when he hears a friend from home has lost, he appears for revenge to defend its honor. His signature style is creeping up into the opponent's blind spot and blasting past right after starting the battle. He sometimes uses nasty tricks, such as pushing the opponent off balance and accelerating past as they stumble. Tuned for acceleration.

Display Name: 裏切りのジャックナイフ
Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. He awoke to driving about half a year ago and quickly became known as one of the strongest on the Loop. He studied under True Slide, Hiroki Itsuki, and has grown into a driver who now stands shoulder to shoulder with his master. He sticks right behind his opponent and pulls ahead the moment a small opening appears. He applies pressure very well, and a leading driver without iron nerves will not avoid mistakes. However, he is still immature at blocking.

Display Name: トゥルー スライド
Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. He was once the leader of TEAM CATZ but was ousted by his members. He turned his bitterness at the expulsion into fighting spirit and wins battle after battle. He reveres Melancholy Angel, Setsuko Kuroe, as a goddess. He drives a deep blue car that blends into the night. Because the machine is not fully lightened, he fitted top-grade brakes that can haul the body into corners, which in turn added even more weight.
Relationships: Former leader of TEAM CATZ; Idolizes Setsuko Kuroe

Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. Her mysterious beauty draws the attention of racers, but she is even more famous for driving skill said to be miraculous. She doubts the existence of Jintei, saying he is a legend born of racers' delusions. She builds a mid-class machine to the limit and can handle both straight-line battles and tight corners. However, weak acceleration makes her poor at short fights; her strategy seems to be dragging the battle out and winning through tenacity.

One of the Thirteen Devils. He grew up in the same orphanage as Fallen Blade and Blood Hound and is as close to them as real brothers. A military enthusiast who collects knives and model guns, he also has a gentle side that loves animals. Either fearless or numb to fear, his ferocious dives and crash-defying driving have no rival even on the Shutoko. His machine is tuned to the limit and easily surpasses the 3000cc class.
Relationships: Orphanage brother to Hiromasa Fujishita and Shiro Sasaki

Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. He comes from the same orphanage as Hard Weapon (Toshiki Takasaki) and Blood Hound (Shiro Sasaki). He is the coolest and most realistic of the three, and a fanatical horror movie fan. With a thoroughly lightened body and a fiercely tuned engine, he has recorded around 300 km/h on the Fukagawa and Bayshore routes. The car is lowered, yet its behavior still seems unstable, and it is weak against left-right shaking.
Relationships: Orphanage brother to Toshiki Takasaki and Shiro Sasaki

Display Name: ブラッド ハウンド
Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. He is the one who pulled Hard Weapon and Fallen Blade into the racing world. The leader of the three, he holds a strong admiration for Jintei. He is a disciple of Sitar Kaneyama (Daigo Kaneyama). He handles a high-power machine skillfully and is said to be the strongest sedan driver on the Shutoko. He shows light handling that hides the car's weight, and is especially good at hiding behind trucks and the like to catch opponents off guard.
Relationships: Disciple of Daigo Kaneyama; Orphanage brother to Toshiki Takasaki and Hiromasa Fujishita

Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. A rumor says that anyone who battles him never comes back here, and as a result nobody will fight him. He only battles those driving fast cars. He is the ex-boyfriend of Melancholy Angel, Setsuko Kuroe. His jet-black body and menacing front face are intimidating. He crushes opponents utterly in battle and plants deep scars in their hearts. Lately he is said to pick strong opponents so that he does not run out of people to fight.

One of the Thirteen Devils. While seeking the ultimate in driving, he went to India for training to forge his mind. He burns incense in the car to heighten his concentration. He found enlightenment in Jintei's driving and takes him as his goal. His outstanding focus and steel willpower mean he never gives up. He sticks to the opponent's tail and closely observes their driving style, and burns even hotter when passed. His front-lowered setup gives quick cornering.

Display Name: スティール ハート
Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils. A man who thinks of nothing but cars day and night and is indifferent to women, yet he has many female fans. Lucifer Otsuka and Sitar Kaneyama are his disciples. His cool judgment never misses even the slightest chance to win. Conversely, he never lets his guard down even when leading, so passing him is extremely difficult. The machine is built orthodoxly, with a sensible, unforced specification.
Relationships: Master of Ichiji Otsuka and Daigo Kaneyama

Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils, and one of those called the Four Heavenly Kings. He shows genius-level sharpness of technique and excels at tight curves, cornering at right angles. He once considered retiring, but the appearance of Jintei lit his fighting spirit. He picked his car with the conviction that if you want sporty, it is the Z15. He is now completely in love with his car, which delivers more power than imagined when tuned. He keeps the revs high with low gearing and a close-ratio setup.

One of the Thirteen Devils, and one of those called the Four Heavenly Kings. The other Devils loathe him for his sly personality. He boasts that he once ran with Jintei, but whether that is true is unknown. His dangerous driving has an eerie intensity. A high-speed tune yields astonishing top speed, and he drives as if possessed by something dangerous. He covers the lack of low-rev torque with an advanced technique called zero counter, which avoids counter-steering to hold back deceleration.

Display Name: 追撃のテイルガンナー
Bio: One of the Thirteen Devils, and one of those called the Four Heavenly Kings. He once climbed to within a step of the Shutoko's fastest seat. He is convinced that Jintei is the racer he has been seeking, and keeps running as if burning out what life he has left. Steady driving is his creed. He never does anything reckless, yet he is still fast enough, thanks to accurate judgment and a high-power engine. He is apparently still not satisfied with his suspension tuning.

One of the Thirteen Devils, and one of those called the Four Heavenly Kings. She fiercely rivaled Tailgunner of Pursuit, but with the appearance of Jintei she became convinced he is the true rival she was seeking, and her fighting spirit has been reignited anew. She tends to cover technique with machine power, but she certainly has the skill to handle that power. She uses a very old model, but the inside carries the latest parts and the exterior is heavily modified.

He appeared on the Shutoko on a hot night out of nowhere, beat the leaders of racer teams one after another, and rose to the top. His identity is wrapped in mystery, but rumor says he is still a young man in his early twenties. He always appears suddenly. His overwhelming launch acceleration, the monstrous engine that pulls him straight to top speed, and the high skill to handle it are beyond human. He can perfectly predict the movement of ordinary traffic and even box opponents in.

Display Name: ミッドナイト ローズ
Bio: Despite her queenly appearance, she is friendly and easygoing. She is an object of admiration for the racers who run this area. Few know her background, and speculation ranges from career woman to uptown housewife. Her driving is as gorgeous as she is. It looks quite rough, but that induces pressure on her battle opponents. She also cares about dress-up and swaps out even slightly aged parts right away.

His past is a mystery, though there are rumors that he was once in RINGS. He is an old rival of White Charisma. Now that Jintei has been defeated, he aims for the top again with sharpened technique and a more powerful machine. Hardly any part of the machine remains untouched. The tune ignores balance and focuses only on power, which turned the machine into a monster that ordinary drivers cannot handle.
Relationships: Former member of RINGS; Rivals Wataru Tachi

Bio: He was a team leader, but following the saying that there is always only one summit, he resolved to disband and began running alone. As a former leader, his technique is the real thing. His name spread quickly and he joined the Twelve Conquerors. His driving is rough, but his cornering is delicate. He keeps grip with small steering inputs and exits at godlike speed. On the other hand, on fast straights his roughness stands out and he often drags other cars into trouble.

He left the Shutoko in protest against the Thirteen Devils, but returned upon hearing the news of Jintei's defeat. With his friendly nature, you would never imagine he is one of the Twelve Conquerors. Yet his technique goes beyond human limits. He intimidates opponents with constant edge-of-the-limit driving. Mentally he seems to have room to spare, deliberately easing off the throttle to toy with them. His arrogant driving occasionally leads to mistakes, which perhaps is part of his charm.

Display Name: ブルー プレッシャー
Bio: He formed a team, but was so selfish that no members gathered, so he runs alone. Ironically, this is what got him called one of the Twelve Conquerors. He buys many parts at once, so shops love him. His driving shows no inconsistency at all. He keeps the same driving style on any course. That composure has a big psychological effect on opponents. However, never breaking his own pace at the critical moment can sometimes be a flaw.

He climbed to within reach of an F1 seat, but gave it up after an unexpected accident. With Jintei's defeat as his chance, he decided to start a second life aiming for the top of the Shutoko. Recently he wrote a novel based on his own experiences and won a new writer's award. Having aimed to be an F1 driver, he drives with maturity. Perhaps due to the accident, his driving is surprisingly cautious, and he will not go for a big gamble unless very confident. His tuning and setup suit connoisseurs.

He knew and admired Uncrowned Emperor from his active racing days. He is now the better driver but never forgets his respect. He is stoic in driving but gentle at heart. He has talent for tuning and keeps his car perfectly maintained. A power supremacist. The engine is tuned almost to perfection and brought to its full potential, so he drives stably at any speed. If there is a problem, it may be the driver's overly kind personality.

His ability is top-level even among the Twelve Conquerors. Respected by many racers, he is stoic enough not to be carried away by his popularity. With Jintei defeated, he sees now as the greatest chance and burns to make a name for himself aggressively. He favors a machine built with meticulous care for the engine, muffler, and even air resistance. His aggressive driving is said to put mental pressure on opponents. Weaving through ordinary traffic, he lives up to the name Demon.

Display Name: クイーンズ ナイト
Bio: A 28-year-old who turned down invitations to turn pro and sticks with the Shutoko. Because he loves the Shutoko, he will never tolerate half-hearted racers. On the other hand, he takes great care of racers he likes and generously gives away parts. His head holds all the data on Shutoko racers, and he has nearly studied every opponent's moves. At times he drives to test the opponent. He shows more drive against strong opponents, but never underestimates weak ones.

Jintei's master. He had already retired, but returned to the Shutoko to avenge his carefully trained disciple's defeat. His driving shows no sign of a layoff, and he was soon counted among the Twelve Conquerors. An old-school racer who fiddles with his car until satisfied. The machine itself cannot match the latest sports cars, but his far-beyond-common passing skill and tenacious blocking thoroughly crush opponents mentally.

Display Name: エキゾースト イブ
Bio: A gorgeous woman, highly self-conscious. She scorns the Thirteen Devils as a gathering of children and had stepped down from the Shutoko stage. Everyone knows the real reason is that she was not standing out. The engine, built with an emphasis on torque, has frightening acceleration. However, top-speed gain is lacking, so she is somewhat at a disadvantage on straights. Also, the suspension is hardly modified, so her cornering is unstable.

A legendary presence whose name alone made any racer tremble, but he was defeated by Jintei and vanished. After he left, he reappeared on the Shutoko and instantly took the summit. He rides a monster machine with an ultimate tune and homemade aero parts. The sturdy drivetrain, able to withstand the power, draws 120% of the machine's potential. His driving, reading two or three moves ahead, has not a single opening.

There are many rumors, such as a monster that haunts the Shutoko or the ghost of a legendary racer who ran decades ago, but all agree on one thing: it only appears before those who have truly mastered driving. The body is a famous car of the past, but the inside is completely different. Its terrifying acceleration and beyond-common cornering are truly worthy of legend. When leading it saps the will of those chasing, and when chasing it keeps up constant pressure.
